package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector

import chisel3._
import chiseltest._
import org.scalatest.flatspec.AnyFlatSpec
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers
import scala.util.Random

class VDot8Test extends AnyFlatSpec with ChiselScalatestTester with Matchers {
  private def pack(bytes: Seq[Int], high: BigInt): BigInt =
    (high << 64) | bytes.zipWithIndex.map { case (b, i) => BigInt(b & 255) << (8 * i) }.reduce(_ | _)

  behavior of "VDot8"
  it should "produce exact signed sums with enabled stages, bubbles and poisoned upper bytes" in {
    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
      val random = new Random(0x56444f54L)
      val directed = Seq(
        (1 to 8, Seq.fill(8)(1)),
        (1 to 8, (1 to 8).reverse),
        ((1 to 8).map(-_), Seq.fill(8)(1)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(-128)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(127), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(0), Seq.fill(8)(-128))
      )
      val vectors = directed ++ Seq.fill(1000)(
        (Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128), Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128)))
      var stage1: Option[BigInt] = None
      var stage2: Option[BigInt] = None
      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
      dut.io.vs1.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(0.U)
      dut.clock.step()
      for ((a, b) <- vectors) {
        // Model each enabled register independently, including simultaneous
        // advance, disabled holds and transfer without a new input.
        for (_ <- 0 until (if (random.nextBoolean()) 1 else 2)) {
          val en1 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
          val en2 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
          val sum = BigInt(a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => x * y }.sum) & 0xffffffffL
          dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(a, BigInt(64, random)).U)
          dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(b, BigInt(64, random)).U)
          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
          val next2 = if (en2) stage1 else stage2
          if (en1) stage1 = Some(sum)
          dut.clock.step()
          stage2 = next2
          stage2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
        }
      }
      // Explicit endpoint: 18 signed bits cannot hold this result.
      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.result.expect(BigInt(131072).U)
    }
  }

  it should "hold a negative full-register result while disabled inputs keep changing" in {
    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(127), 0).U)
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      val expected = BigInt(-130048) & BigInt("ffffffff", 16)
      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
      val random = new Random(0x484f4c44L)
      for (_ <- 0 until 96) {
        dut.io.vs1.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
        dut.io.vs2.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
        dut.clock.step()
        dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
      }
      // Stage-one holds must preserve the products for a later transfer too.
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
    }
  }

  it should "switch e8 and e16 with independent stage enables and exact wide endpoints across seeds" in {
    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
      var s1: Option[BigInt] = None
      var s2: Option[BigInt] = None
      for (seed <- Seq(1L, 0x56444f54L, 0x9e3779b9L, 0xdeadbeefL)) {
        val random = new Random(seed)
        for (n <- 0 until 520) {
          val bits = if (n % 2 == 0) 16 else 8
          val mask = (BigInt(1) << bits) - 1
          val min = -(1 << (bits - 1))
          val a = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 4) min else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
          val b = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 2) min else if (n < 4) -min - 1 else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
          def packed(xs: Seq[Int]): BigInt = xs.zipWithIndex.map {
            case (v, i) => (BigInt(v) & mask) << (bits * i)
          }.foldLeft(if (bits == 8) BigInt(64, random) << 64 else BigInt(0))(_ | _)
          val expected = a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => BigInt(x) * BigInt(y) }.sum &
            ((BigInt(1) << (if (bits == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
          val en1 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
          val en2 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
          dut.io.sew16.poke((bits == 16).B)
          dut.io.vs1.poke(packed(a).U)
          dut.io.vs2.poke(packed(b).U)
          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
          val next = if (en2) s1 else s2
          if (en1) s1 = Some(expected)
          dut.clock.step()
          s2 = next
          s2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
        }
      }
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      s1.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
    }
  }
}

    val v0Dest = Input(Bool())

    val outTag = Output(UInt(8.W))

      case utility.LogUtilsOptionsKey => utility.LogUtilsOptions(

    }
    test(new VDotIntegrationHarness()(testConfig)).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>

      val byteTwos = BigInt("02" * 16, 16)

      var issued = 0
      var checked = 0
      dut.io.valid.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.cancel.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.op.poke(VdotOpType.vdot)
      dut.io.tag.poke(1.U)
      dut.io.vs1.poke(byteOnes.U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(byteTwos.U)
      dut.io.oldVd.poke(((BigInt(1) << 128) - 1).U)
      dut.io.mask.poke(((BigInt(1) << 128) - 1).U)
      dut.io.vxrm.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vm.poke(true.B)
      dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.v0Dest.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.illegal.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vlmul.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.config.vl.poke(8.U)
      dut.clock.step(3)

      def tick(input: Option[Expected], op: BigInt = 0x160, vl: Int = 8,
               vm: Boolean = true, start: Int = 0, cancel: Boolean = false,
               old: BigInt = (BigInt(1) << 128) - 1, sew: Int = 0): Unit = {
        dut.io.valid.poke(input.nonEmpty.B)
        dut.io.cancel.poke(cancel.B)
        dut.io.op.poke(op.U)
        dut.io.config.vl.poke(vl.U)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(sew.U)
        dut.io.vm.poke(vm.B)
        dut.io.vstart.poke(start.U)
        dut.io.oldVd.poke(old.U)
        dut.io.tag.poke(input.map(_.tag).getOrElse(1).U)
        dut.io.v0Dest.poke(input.exists(_.v0).B)
        if (cancel) pending = List(None, None)
        dut.clock.step()
        pending = input.filter(_ => !cancel) :: pending.take(1)
        pending(1) match {
          case Some(e) =>
            dut.io.outValid.expect(true.B)
            dut.io.outTag.expect(e.tag.U)
            dut.io.illegal.expect(e.illegal.B)
            dut.io.saturated.expect(false.B)
            dut.io.vecWen.expect((!e.v0).B)
            dut.io.v0Wen.expect(e.v0.B)
            if (!e.illegal) dut.io.result.expect(e.data.U)
            checked += 1
          case None => dut.io.outValid.expect(false.B)
        }
        if (input.nonEmpty) issued += 1
      }
      for (i <- 1 to 16) {
        val isMul = i % 2 == 0
        dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke((!isMul && i % 3 == 0).B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke((i % 4 == 0).B)
        val result = if (isMul) (byteTwos & ((BigInt(1) << 64) - 1)) else BigInt(16)

        tick(Some(Expected(i, result, false, i % 5 == 0)),
          if (isMul) VimacType.vmul.litValue else BigInt(0x160), old = 0)
        if (i % 3 == 0) tick(None)
      }
      for (vl <- Seq(0, 1, 7, 9, 16)) tick(Some(Expected(20 + vl, 0, true, false)), vl = vl)
      tick(Some(Expected(40, 0, true, false)), vm = false)
      tick(Some(Expected(41, 0, true, false)), start = 1)
      for (vl <- Seq(0, 1, 7, 9)) tick(Some(Expected(50, 0, true, false)), vl = vl, sew = 1)
      tick(Some(Expected(51, 0, true, false)), sew = 2)
      tick(Some(Expected(52, 1056784, false, true)), sew = 1)
      tick(None)
      tick(None)
      tick(Some(Expected(42, 16, false, false)))
      tick(None, cancel = true)
      tick(None)
      tick(Some(Expected(43, 16, false, true)))
      tick(None)
      tick(None)
      checked shouldBe issued - 1
    }
  }

  it should "preserve randomized mixed traffic and ordinary mask tail multiply accumulate and saturation" in {
    val testConfig = config.alterPartial {
      case utility.LogUtilsOptionsKey => utility.LogUtilsOptions(
        enableDebug = false, enablePerf = false, fpgaPlatform = true)
    }
    test(new VDotIntegrationHarness()(testConfig)).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
      var random = new scala.util.Random(0x49534f4cL)
      val full = (BigInt(1) << 128) - 1
      case class Expected(tag: Int, result: BigInt, saturated: Boolean)
      var pending = List.fill[Option[Expected]](2)(None)
      var checked = 0
      var issued = 0
      var killed = 0

      def signed(x: BigInt, width: Int): BigInt =
        if (x.testBit(width - 1)) x - (BigInt(1) << width) else x

      def tick(kind: String, sew: Int = 8, valid: Boolean = true, cancel: Boolean = false,
               forceSat: Boolean = false): Unit = {
        val dot = kind == "dot"
        val width = sew
        val count = 128 / width
        val elemMask = (BigInt(1) << width) - 1
        val a = if (forceSat) BigInt("80" * 16, 16) else BigInt(128, random)
        val b = if (forceSat) a else BigInt(128, random)
        val old = BigInt(128, random)
        val mask = BigInt(128, random)
        val vl = if (dot) 8 else if (forceSat) count else random.nextInt(count + 1)
        val vm = dot || forceSat || random.nextBoolean()
        val ta = random.nextBoolean()
        val ma = random.nextBoolean()
        val tag = issued % 63 + 1
        val op = kind match {
          case "dot" => VdotOpType.vdot
          case "mul" => VimacType.vmul
          case "macc" => VimacType.vmacc
          case "madd" => VimacType.vmadd
          case "nmsac" => VimacType.vnmsac
          case "smul" => VimacType.vsmul
        }
        var sat = false
        val result = if (dot) {
          (0 until 8).map { i =>
            signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width) * signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
          }.sum & ((BigInt(1) << (if (width == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
        } else {
          (0 until count).map { i =>
            val x = signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
            val y = signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
            val z = (old >> (width * i)) & elemMask
            val active = i < vl && (vm || mask.testBit(i))
            val product = kind match {
              case "mul" => x * y
              case "macc" => x * y + z
              case "madd" => x * signed(z, width) + y
              case "nmsac" => z - x * y
              case "smul" =>
                val overflow = x == -(BigInt(1) << (width - 1)) && x == y
                if (active && overflow) sat = true
                if (overflow) (BigInt(1) << (width - 1)) - 1 else (x * y) >> (width - 1)
            }
            // vstart >= vl preserves the whole destination, even with ta/ma.
            val value = if (vl == 0) z else if (active) product & elemMask
              else if ((i >= vl && ta) || (i < vl && ma)) elemMask else z
            value << (width * i)
          }.foldLeft(BigInt(0))(_ | _)
        }
        dut.io.valid.poke(valid.B)
        dut.io.cancel.poke(cancel.B)
        dut.io.op.poke(op)
        dut.io.tag.poke(tag.U)
        dut.io.vs1.poke(a.U)
        dut.io.vs2.poke(b.U)
        dut.io.oldVd.poke(old.U)
        dut.io.mask.poke(mask.U)
        dut.io.vxrm.poke(2.U) // RDN: signed arithmetic shift in the oracle.
        dut.io.vm.poke(vm.B)
        dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
        dut.io.v0Dest.poke(false.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.illegal.poke(false.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke(ta.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke(ma.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(width / 8).U)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vlmul.poke(0.U)
        dut.io.config.vl.poke(vl.U)
        if (cancel) {
          killed += pending.take(1).count(_.nonEmpty)
          pending = List(None, None)
        }
        val input = if (valid && !cancel) Some(Expected(tag, result & full, sat)) else None
        dut.clock.step()
        pending = input :: pending.take(1)
        pending(1) match {
          case Some(e) =>
            dut.io.outValid.expect(true.B)
            dut.io.outTag.expect(e.tag.U)
            dut.io.illegal.expect(false.B)
            dut.io.result.expect(e.result.U)
            dut.io.saturated.expect(e.saturated.B)
            checked += 1
          case None => dut.io.outValid.expect(false.B)
        }
        if (input.nonEmpty) issued += 1
      }

      for (_ <- 0 until 3) tick("mul", valid = false)
      // Long homogeneous windows also supply switching/hold audit evidence.
      for (_ <- 0 until 32) tick("dot")
      for (_ <- 0 until 32) tick("mul", sew = 32)
      for (seed <- Seq(0x49534f4cL, 1L, 0x9e3779b9L, 0xdeadbeefL); i <- 0 until 240) {
        if (i == 0) random = new scala.util.Random(seed)
        val kinds = Seq("dot", "mul", "macc", "madd", "nmsac", "smul")
        val kind = kinds(i % kinds.size)
        tick(kind, sew = if (kind == "dot") Seq(8, 16)((i / 6) % 2)
          else Seq(8, 16, 32, 64)((i / 6) % 4))
        if (i % 11 == 0) tick("mul", valid = false)
        if (i % 37 == 0) tick("dot", valid = false, cancel = true)
      }
      tick("smul", forceSat = true)
      tick("dot")
      tick("smul", forceSat = true)
      for (_ <- 0 until 12) tick("mul", valid = false)
      checked shouldBe issued - killed
      println(s"e8/e16 isolation functional PASS: issued=$issued checked=$checked canceled=$killed seeds=4")
    }
  }
}

      val full = (BigInt(1) << 128) - 1
      case class Expected(tag: Int, result: BigInt, saturated: Boolean)
      var pending = List.fill[Option[Expected]](2)(None)
      var checked = 0
      var issued = 0
      var killed = 0

      def signed(x: BigInt, width: Int): BigInt =
        if (x.testBit(width - 1)) x - (BigInt(1) << width) else x

      def tick(kind: String, sew: Int = 8, valid: Boolean = true, cancel: Boolean = false,
               forceSat: Boolean = false): Unit = {
        val dot = kind == "dot"
        val width = sew
        val count = 128 / width
        val elemMask = (BigInt(1) << width) - 1
        val a = if (forceSat) BigInt("80" * 16, 16) else BigInt(128, random)
        val b = if (forceSat) a else BigInt(128, random)
        val old = BigInt(128, random)
        val mask = BigInt(128, random)
        val vl = if (dot) 8 else if (forceSat) count else random.nextInt(count + 1)
        val vm = dot || forceSat || random.nextBoolean()
        val ta = random.nextBoolean()
        val ma = random.nextBoolean()
        val tag = issued % 63 + 1
        val op = kind match {
          case "dot" => VdotOpType.vdot
          case "mul" => VimacType.vmul
          case "macc" => VimacType.vmacc
          case "madd" => VimacType.vmadd
          case "nmsac" => VimacType.vnmsac
          case "smul" => VimacType.vsmul
        }
        var sat = false
        val result = if (dot) {
          (0 until 8).map { i =>
            signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width) * signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
          }.sum & ((BigInt(1) << (if (width == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
        } else {
          (0 until count).map { i =>
            val x = signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
            val y = signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
            val z = (old >> (width * i)) & elemMask
            val active = i < vl && (vm || mask.testBit(i))
            val product = kind match {
              case "mul" => x * y
              case "macc" => x * y + z
              case "madd" => x * signed(z, width) + y
              case "nmsac" => z - x * y

            val value = if (vl == 0) z else if (active) product & elemMask
              else if ((i >= vl && ta) || (i < vl && ma)) elemMask else z
            value << (width * i)

        }

        dut.io.cancel.poke(cancel.B)

        dut.io.tag.poke(tag.U)
        dut.io.vs1.poke(a.U)
        dut.io.vs2.poke(b.U)
        dut.io.oldVd.poke(old.U)
        dut.io.mask.poke(mask.U)

        dut.io.vm.poke(vm.B)
        dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
        dut.io.v0Dest.poke(false.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.illegal.poke(false.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke(ta.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke(ma.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(width / 8).U)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vlmul.poke(0.U)
        dut.io.config.vl.poke(vl.U)

        pending(1) match {

            dut.io.illegal.expect(false.B)
            dut.io.result.expect(e.result.U)
            dut.io.saturated.expect(e.saturated.B)
            checked += 1
          case None => dut.io.outValid.expect(false.B)
        }
        if (input.nonEmpty) issued += 1
      }

      for (_ <- 0 until 3) tick("mul", valid = false)
      // 较长的同类指令窗口也用于检查翻转活动与禁用保持。
      for (_ <- 0 until 32) tick("dot")
      for (_ <- 0 until 32) tick("mul", sew = 32)
      for (seed <- Seq(0x49534f4cL, 1L, 0x9e3779b9L, 0xdeadbeefL); i <- 0 until 240) {

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reuse frozen sew16 RTL; add read-only model visibility and a low-phase logger."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
XS=ROOT.parent/'XiangShan'
BASE=XS/'build/sew16-fixed8'
BUILD=XS/'build/sew16-events'
SRC=ROOT/'stage2/e16-events'

def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()

def run(args,**kw):
    print('[command]',*map(str,args),flush=True)
    subprocess.run(list(map(str,args)),check=True,**kw)

def generate_fields():
    header=(BUILD/'emu-compile/VSimTop___024root.h').read_text()
    base='SimTop__DOT__l_soc__DOT__core_with_l2__DOT__core__DOT__backend__DOT__'
    paths=dict(d=base+'inner_ctrlBlock__DOT__dispatch__DOT__',
      r=base+'inner_ctrlBlock__DOT__rob__DOT__',
      c=base+'inner_ctrlBlock__DOT__',
      e=base+'inner_vfExuBlock__DOT__exus__DOT__',
      u=base+'inner_vfExuBlock__DOT__exus__DOT__Vimac__DOT__',
      v=base+'inner_vfExuBlock__DOT__exus__DOT__Vimac__DOT__vdot__DOT__')
    used=[]
    def s(group,name):
        full=paths[group]+name
        assert full+';' in header,f'missing retained model field {full}'
        used.append(full)
        return 'r->'+full
    def tag(group,prefix):return f'(256u*{s(group,prefix+"flag")}+{s(group,prefix+"value")})'
    def wide(group,name):
        value=s(group,name)
        return '{'+','.join(f'{value}[{i}]' for i in range(4))+'}'
    lines=['#pragma once','#include "VSimTop___024root.h"','namespace e16events {',
      'inline void sample_model(const VSimTop___024root *r, uint64_t cycle) {',
      'auto &collector=instance(); if(!collector.enabled()) return;',
      'Frame f{}; f.cycle=cycle; f.reset=r->reset;']
    for i in range(6):
        p=f'io_enqRob_req_{i}_bits_'
        lines.append(f'f.alloc[{i}]={{bool({s("d","io_enqRob_canAccept")} && {s("d",f"io_enqRob_req_{i}_valid")}),{tag("d",p+"robIdx_")},{s("d",p+"pc")},{s("d",p+"instr")},{s("d",p+"vpu_vsew")}}};')
    for i in range(8):
        lines.append(f'f.commit[{i}]={{bool({s("r","io_commits_isCommit")} && {s("r",f"io_commits_commitValid_{i}")}),{tag("r",f"io_commits_robIdx_{i}_")}}};')
    for j,i in enumerate((1,3,5,7)):
        p=f'io_fromWB_wbData_{i}_bits_redirect_bits_'
        lines.append(f'f.decision[{j}]={{bool({s("c",f"io_fromWB_wbData_{i}_valid")} && {s("c",f"io_fromWB_wbData_{i}_bits_redirect_valid")}),{tag("c",p+"robIdx_")},bool({s("c",p+"cfiUpdate_taken")}),bool({s("c",p+"cfiUpdate_isMisPred")})}};')
    i_values=['bool('+s('v','io_enable_0')+')',tag('e','io_in_bits_robIdx_'),s('u','io_in_bits_ctrl_vpu_vsew'),
      '('+s('e','io_in_bits_src_4')+'[0] & 255u)']
    i_values += [s('e','io_in_bits_vpu_'+n) for n in ('vlmul','vm','vstart','vill')]
    i_values += [wide('u','io_in_bits_data_src_'+str(n)) for n in (0,1)]
    lines.append('f.input={'+','.join(i_values)+'};')
    o_values=['bool('+s('u','io_out_valid')+' && '+s('u','io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_fuOpType')+'==0x160)',
      tag('u','io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_'),s('u','io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_vpu_vsew'),s('u','io_in_bits_dataPipe_2_src_4')]
    o_values += [s('u','io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_vpu_'+n) for n in ('vlmul','vm','vstart','vill')]
    o_values += [s('u','io_out_bits_ctrl_exceptionVec_2'),wide('u','io_out_bits_res_data')]
    lines.append('f.output={'+','.join(o_values)+'};')
    for name,group,prefix in (('redirect','c','io_redirect_'),('flush','r','io_flushOut_')):
        lines.append(f'f.{name}={{bool({s(group,prefix+"valid")}),{tag(group,prefix+"bits_robIdx_")},{s(group,prefix+"bits_level")}}};')
    lines += ['f.exception='+s('r','io_exception_valid')+';',
      'f.instruction='+s('r','io_exception_bits_instr')+';',
      'f.illegal='+s('r','io_exception_bits_exceptionVec_2')+';',
      'collector.sample(f);','}','}']
    (BUILD/'emulator/event_fields.h').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
    (BUILD/'observed-fields.json').write_text(json.dumps(sorted(set(used)),indent=2))

def main():
    assert not BUILD.exists(),'event build exists; inspect logs before resuming'
    BUILD.mkdir(parents=True)
    files=list((BASE/'rtl').glob('*.sv'))+list((BASE/'generated-src').rglob('*'))
    files=[p for p in files if p.is_file()]
    files += [BASE/'emu',ROOT.parent/'NEMU/build/sew16/riscv64-nemu-interpreter-so',
      XS/'difftest/src/test/csrc/verilator/emu.cpp',SRC/'collector.h',SRC/'visibility.vlt',Path(__file__)]
    inputs={str(p.resolve()):sha(p) for p in files}
    (BUILD/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(inputs,indent=2))
    shutil.copytree(BASE/'generated-src',BUILD/'generated-src')
    for n in ('chisel_db.cpp','chisel_db.h'):shutil.copy2(BASE/n,BUILD/n)
    shutil.copytree(XS/'difftest/src/test/csrc/verilator',BUILD/'emulator')
    emu=BUILD/'emulator/emu.cpp'
    text=emu.read_text()
    assert text.count('#include "emu.h"')==1
    text=text.replace('#include "emu.h"','#include "emu.h"\n#include "collector.h"',1)
    start=text.index('inline void Emulator::single_cycle()')
    pos=text.index('  dut_ptr->eval();',text.index('  dut_ptr->clock = 0;',start))+len('  dut_ptr->eval();')
    text=text[:pos]+'\n  e16events::sample_model(dut_ptr->rootp, cycles);'+text[pos:]
    emu.write_text(text)
    shutil.copy2(SRC/'collector.h',BUILD/'emulator/collector.h')
    args=['make','-C',XS/'difftest',f'BUILD_DIR={BUILD}',f'RTL_DIR={BASE/"rtl"}',
      f'DESIGN_DIR={XS}','NUM_CORES=1','WITH_DRAMSIM3=1','WITH_CONSTANTIN=0',
      'EMU_THREADS=0','EMU_TRACE=0',f'EMU_CSRC_DIR={BUILD/"emulator"}','-j2']
    env=os.environ.copy();env['NOOP_HOME']=str(XS);env['NEMU_HOME']=str(ROOT.parent/'NEMU')
    env['DRAMSIM3_HOME']=str(ROOT.parent/'DRAMsim3')
    env['VEXTRA_FLAGS']=str(SRC/'visibility.vlt')
    run(args+[str(BUILD/'emu-compile/VSimTop.mk')],env=env)
    generate_fields()
    run(args+['build_emu'],env=env)
    assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in inputs.items()),'frozen input changed'
    (BUILD/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',emu_sha256=sha(BUILD/'emu'),
      rtl_source='sew16-fixed8/rtl',waveform=False,mode='read-only public_flat_rd and C++ settled-low events'),indent=2))
    print('[event build COMPLETE]',BUILD/'emu',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay the frozen original full image; locate and capture e2e windows."""
import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OLD = ROOT/'stage3/logs/20261006T060358-16-isolation-perf-full-run0-20261006T063347-16-bench.full.log'
COMMIT = re.compile(r'\[\d{2}\] commit pc ([0-9a-f]+) inst ([0-9a-f]+) wen (\d+) dst (\d+) data ([0-9a-f]+) idx [0-9a-f]+[^\n]*\n')

def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)

def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result

def write(path, value):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write('\n')

def calibrate(path):
    scope, selected, values, offsets = [], {}, {}, []
    time, clock = 0, None
    def sample():
        nonlocal clock
        current=values.get('clock')
        if clock==1 and current==0 and 'mcycle' in values and 'cycle' in values:
            offsets.append(dict(time=time,mcycle=values['mcycle'],cycle=values['cycle'],offset=(values['mcycle']-values['cycle']) % (1<<64)))
        clock=current
    with path.open() as stream:
        header=True
        for line in stream:
            line=line.strip()
            fields=line.split()
            if header:
                if line.startswith('$scope'): scope.append(fields[2])
                elif line.startswith('$upscope'): scope.pop()
                elif line.startswith('$var'):
                    name='.'.join(scope+[fields[4]])
                    if name=='TOP.clock': selected[fields[3]]='clock'
                    elif name.endswith('.csr.csrMod.mcycle.reg_ALL'): selected[fields[3]]='mcycle'
                    elif name.endswith('.rob.difftest_module_8.io_bits_cycleCnt'): selected[fields[3]]='cycle'
                elif line.startswith('$enddefinitions'):
                    need(set(selected.values())=={'clock','mcycle','cycle'}, 'missing boot calibration signals: '+str(selected))
                    header=False
                continue
            if line.startswith('#'):
                sample(); time=int(line[1:])
            elif line.startswith('b'):
                bits,code=line[1:].split()
                if code in selected and not re.search('[xz]',bits): values[selected[code]]=int(bits,2)
            elif line[:1] in ('0','1') and line[1:].strip() in selected:
                values[selected[line[1:].strip()]]=int(line[0])
    sample()
    stable=[x for x in offsets if x['cycle']>=8]
    need(len(stable)>=8 and len({x['offset'] for x in stable})==1, 'unstable mcycle/trap calibration')
    return dict(offset=stable[-1]['offset'],samples=stable,wave_sha256=sha(path),qualification='short boot calibration only, NOT full architectural regression')

def windows(text):
    """Original ELF PCs, never inferred from changed diagnostic ELF layouts."""
    pending = None
    pairs = []
    for match in COMMIT.finditer(text):
        pc, inst, wen, dst, data = match.groups()
        pc, inst, data = int(pc,16), int(inst,16), int(data,16)
        if pc in (0x8000034c, 0x800003d4, 0x80000448, 0x800004a0):
            need(pending is None and inst == 0xb0002373 and (wen,dst)==('1','06'), 'invalid start timestamp')
            pending = dict(start=data, start_pc=hex(pc))
        elif pc == 0x800004c8:
            need(pending is not None and inst == 0xb0002e73 and (wen,dst)==('1','28'), 'invalid end timestamp')
            pending.update(end=data, cycles=data-pending['start'])
            pairs.append(pending)
            pending = None
    need(pending is None and len(pairs)==96, 'need all 96 original kernel timestamp pairs')
    for n, pair in enumerate(pairs):
        kind, position = divmod(n,32)
        phase, within = divmod(position,16)
        rep, slot = divmod(within,2)
        impl = rep % 2 ^ slot
        expected_pc = ((0x800003d4,0x8000034c),(0x800003d4,0x8000034c),(0x800004a0,0x80000448))[kind][impl]
        need(pair['start_pc']==hex(expected_pc), 'call order/implementation differs from original first=0')
        need(pair['cycles']>0 and (not n or pair['start']>pairs[n-1]['end']), 'nonmonotonic timestamps')
        pair.update(index=n, kind=('batch4','e2e','chain')[kind], phase=('warm','measured')[phase], rep=rep, slot=slot, impl=('vdot','rvv')[impl])
    return pairs

def main():
    # Both locks are kept for the entire two-pass workflow.
    locks=[]
    for name in ('benchmark.lock','e2e-diagnostic.lock'):
        lock=(ROOT/'stage3/logs'/name).open('a')
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        locks.append(lock)
    guard=module('event_guard',ROOT/'scripts/complete-vdot-isolation-performance.py')
    state=json.loads((ROOT/'stage3/logs/20261006T060358-16-isolation-perf.state.json').read_text())
    guard.check_frozen(state)
    old=OLD.read_text()
    emu=ROOT.parent/'XiangShan/build/operand-isolation/emu'
    ref=ROOT.parent/'NEMU/build/riscv64-nemu-interpreter-so'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed full-core control evidence; never infer speculation from source code."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

BASE = "TOP.SimTop.l_soc.core_with_l2.core.backend."
CTRL = BASE + "inner_ctrlBlock."
DISPATCH = CTRL + "dispatch."
ROB = CTRL + "rob."
FU = BASE + "inner_vfExuBlock.exus.Vimac."
SYMBOLS = ("control_branch_pc", "control_branch_dot", "control_branch_dot_v0",
           "control_exception_pc", "control_younger_dot", "control_younger_dot_v0",
           "control_younger_dot_alias", "control_exception_resume")
# Pinned DefaultConfig: 160 entries, eight value bits plus one wrap flag.
# Encoded pointer ordering uses a 256 stride, NOT 160. Unused values are
# rejected; modulo-512 differences are ordering comparisons, not uop counts.
ROB_SIZE = 160
PRINTED_SYMBOLS = dict(branch="control_branch_pc", branch_dot="control_branch_dot",
                       branch_v0="control_branch_dot_v0", illegal="control_exception_pc",
                       young="control_younger_dot", young_v0="control_younger_dot_v0",
                       young_alias="control_younger_dot_alias")


def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def audit_log(path, seed):
    text = Path(path).read_text(errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]", "", text)
    # A UART line can be split by complete commit-trace lines. Removing the
    # complete trace INCLUDING its newline rejoins the original UART text.
    text = re.sub(r"\[\d{2}\] commit pc [0-9a-f]+ inst [0-9a-f]+ wen \d+ dst \d+ data [0-9a-f]+ idx [0-9a-f]+[^\n]*\n", "", text)
    expected = (f"control PASS: seed={int(seed,16):x} random=256 branch_train=64 "
                "branch_probe=4 illegal=20 configs=24 config_faults=16 mixed=16x32 chains=16x128")
    need("Difftest enabled" in text and "HIT GOOD TRAP" in text and expected in text,
         "missing exact full-core control PASS/seed/coverage")
    need(not re.search(r"HIT BAD TRAP|ABORT|different at pc|control.*FAIL", text), "core failure")
    need(re.findall(r"^\[process exit\] (\d+)$", text, re.M) == ["0"], "missing actual zero process exit")
    pattern = "control symbols " + " ".join(n+r"=([0-9a-f]+)" for n in PRINTED_SYMBOLS)
    rows = re.findall(pattern, text)
    need(len(rows) == 1, "missing/duplicate runtime symbol report")
    printed = {PRINTED_SYMBOLS[n]:int(v,16) for n,v in zip(PRINTED_SYMBOLS,rows[0])}
    return dict(seed=seed, log_sha256=digest(path), architectural_status="PASS", printed_symbols=printed)


def read_symbols(path):
    # riscv64-linux-gnu-nm -n ELF, frozen alongside each control image.
    found = {}
    for row in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        fields = row.split()
        if len(fields) == 3 and fields[2] in SYMBOLS:
            found[fields[2]] = int(fields[0], 16)
    need(set(found) == set(SYMBOLS), "missing ELF control symbols")
    need(len(set(found.values())) == len(SYMBOLS), "duplicate control symbol addresses")
    return found


def required_signals():
    names = ["TOP.clock", DISPATCH+"io_enqRob_canAccept",
             CTRL+"io_redirect_valid", CTRL+"io_redirect_bits_level",
             ROB+"io_flushOut_valid", ROB+"io_flushOut_bits_level",
             ROB+"io_exception_valid", ROB+"io_exception_bits_exceptionVec_2",
             ROB+"io_exception_bits_instr",
             ROB+"io_commits_isCommit", FU+"io_out_valid",
             FU+"io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_fuOpType", FU+"io_out_bits_res_data"]
    for prefix in (CTRL+"io_redirect_bits_", ROB+"io_flushOut_bits_", FU+"io_out_bits_ctrl_"):
        names += [prefix+"robIdx_"+n for n in ("flag", "value")]
    for i in range(6):
        prefix = DISPATCH+f"io_enqRob_req_{i}_"
        names += [prefix+"valid"] + [prefix+"bits_"+n for n in ("instr", "pc", "robIdx_flag", "robIdx_value")]
    for i in range(8):
        names += [ROB+f"io_commits_commitValid_{i}"]
        names += [ROB+f"io_commits_robIdx_{i}_"+n for n in ("flag", "value")]
    for i in (1, 3, 5, 7):
        prefix = CTRL+f"io_fromWB_wbData_{i}_"
        names += [prefix+"valid", prefix+"bits_redirect_valid"]
        names += [prefix+"bits_redirect_bits_"+n for n in
                  ("robIdx_flag", "robIdx_value", "cfiUpdate_pc", "cfiUpdate_taken", "cfiUpdate_isMisPred")]
    return names


def audit_wave(path, symbols, require_coverage=True):
    scope, signals, values = [], {}, {}
    selected, live, records, flushes, decisions = set(), {}, [], [], {}
    writeback_redirects, accepted_redirects = [], []
    old_clock, time = None, 0
    branch_pc = symbols["control_branch_pc"]
    illegal_pc = symbols["control_exception_pc"]
    wrong_pcs = {symbols[n] for n in ("control_branch_dot", "control_branch_dot_v0")}
    young_pcs = {symbols[n] for n in ("control_younger_dot", "control_younger_dot_v0", "control_younger_dot_alias")}
    wanted_pcs = set(symbols.values())
    serial, phase = 0, 0

    def get(name):
        value = values.get(signals[name])
        need(value is not None, f"unknown {name} at {time}")
        return value

    def tag(prefix):
        flag, value = get(prefix+"robIdx_flag"), get(prefix+"robIdx_value")
        need(flag in (0,1) and 0 <= value < ROB_SIZE, "invalid DefaultConfig ROB pointer")
        return flag * 256 + value

    def flush(origin, kind, level):
        event = dict(time=time, phase=phase, kind=kind, origin=origin, victims=[], settled=False)
        if kind == "branch":
            need(origin in decisions, "branch flush without taken misprediction writeback")
            event["decision_time"] = decisions[origin]
            origin_rec = live.get(origin)
            event["settled"] = origin_rec is not None and "commit_time" in origin_rec
        for robtag, rec in list(live.items()):
            if "squashed_time" in rec or "commit_time" in rec:
                continue
            delta = (robtag-origin) % 512
            if 0 < delta < 256 or (level and delta == 0):
                if rec["pc"] in wrong_pcs | young_pcs:
                    need("commit_time" not in rec, "wrong-path/younger vdot already committed")
                    rec["squashed_time"] = time
                    rec["squash_kind"] = kind
                    event["victims"].append(rec["index"])
                # Retain cancelled relevant tags to catch a later commit, until
                # explicitly reallocated with a new dispatch serial number.
                if rec["pc"] not in wanted_pcs:
                    live.pop(robtag)
        flushes.append(event)

    def sample():
        nonlocal old_clock, serial, phase
        clock = get("TOP.clock")
        falling = old_clock == 1 and clock == 0
        old_clock = clock
        if not falling:
            return
        phase += 1
        # Rob.scala registers io.exception one cycle after io.flushOut. Do
        # not conflate the combinational flush with a stale exception payload.
        for event in flushes:
            if event["kind"] == "exception" and "exception_time" not in event:
                need(phase == event["phase"]+1, "missed precise exception confirmation phase")
                need(get(ROB+"io_exception_valid") and get(ROB+"io_exception_bits_exceptionVec_2") and
                     get(ROB+"io_exception_bits_instr") == 0xffffffff,
                     "illegal flush without its next-cycle registered illegal-exception evidence")
                event["exception_time"] = time
        if get(DISPATCH+"io_enqRob_canAccept"):
            for i in range(6):
                prefix = DISPATCH+f"io_enqRob_req_{i}_"
                if not get(prefix+"valid"):
                    continue
                robtag = tag(prefix+"bits_")
                pc = get(prefix+"bits_pc")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""严格审核整核控制证据，不能从源码存在某条指令推断其已投机执行。"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

BASE = "TOP.SimTop.l_soc.core_with_l2.core.backend."
CTRL = BASE + "inner_ctrlBlock."
DISPATCH = CTRL + "dispatch."
ROB = CTRL + "rob."
FU = BASE + "inner_vfExuBlock.exus.Vimac."
SYMBOLS = ("control_branch_pc", "control_branch_dot", "control_branch_dot_v0",
           "control_exception_pc", "control_younger_dot", "control_younger_dot_v0",
           "control_younger_dot_alias", "control_exception_resume")
# 当前 DefaultConfig：160 项 ROB，指针含 8 位索引和 1 位回绕标志。
# 编码指针的比较步长为 256，而不是 160；拒绝未使用的索引值。
# 模 512 的差用于顺序判断，不能当作 uop 数量。
ROB_SIZE = 160
PRINTED_SYMBOLS = dict(branch="control_branch_pc", branch_dot="control_branch_dot",
                       branch_v0="control_branch_dot_v0", illegal="control_exception_pc",
                       young="control_younger_dot", young_v0="control_younger_dot_v0",
                       young_alias="control_younger_dot_alias")


def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def audit_log(path, seed):
    text = Path(path).read_text(errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]", "", text)
    # UART 文本可能被完整提交跟踪行打断；删除完整跟踪行
    # 及其换行符后，才能重新连接原 UART 文本。
    text = re.sub(r"\[\d{2}\] commit pc [0-9a-f]+ inst [0-9a-f]+ wen \d+ dst \d+ data [0-9a-f]+ idx [0-9a-f]+[^\n]*\n", "", text)
    expected = (f"control PASS: seed={int(seed,16):x} random=256 branch_train=64 "
                "branch_probe=4 illegal=20 configs=24 config_faults=16 mixed=16x32 chains=16x128")
    need("Difftest enabled" in text and "HIT GOOD TRAP" in text and expected in text,
         "missing exact full-core control PASS/seed/coverage")
    need(not re.search(r"HIT BAD TRAP|ABORT|different at pc|control.*FAIL", text), "core failure")
    need(re.findall(r"^\[process exit\] (\d+)$", text, re.M) == ["0"], "missing actual zero process exit")
    pattern = "control symbols " + " ".join(n+r"=([0-9a-f]+)" for n in PRINTED_SYMBOLS)
    rows = re.findall(pattern, text)
    need(len(rows) == 1, "missing/duplicate runtime symbol report")
    printed = {PRINTED_SYMBOLS[n]:int(v,16) for n,v in zip(PRINTED_SYMBOLS,rows[0])}
    return dict(seed=seed, log_sha256=digest(path), architectural_status="PASS", printed_symbols=printed)


def read_symbols(path):
    # 使用 riscv64-linux-gnu-nm -n 的 ELF 符号，符号表与对应镜像一起留存。
    found = {}
    for row in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        fields = row.split()
        if len(fields) == 3 and fields[2] in SYMBOLS:
            found[fields[2]] = int(fields[0], 16)
    need(set(found) == set(SYMBOLS), "missing ELF control symbols")
    need(len(set(found.values())) == len(SYMBOLS), "duplicate control symbol addresses")
    return found


def required_signals():
    names = ["TOP.clock", DISPATCH+"io_enqRob_canAccept",
             CTRL+"io_redirect_valid", CTRL+"io_redirect_bits_level",
             ROB+"io_flushOut_valid", ROB+"io_flushOut_bits_level",
             ROB+"io_exception_valid", ROB+"io_exception_bits_exceptionVec_2",
             ROB+"io_exception_bits_instr",
             ROB+"io_commits_isCommit", FU+"io_out_valid",
             FU+"io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_fuOpType", FU+"io_out_bits_res_data"]
    for prefix in (CTRL+"io_redirect_bits_", ROB+"io_flushOut_bits_", FU+"io_out_bits_ctrl_"):
        names += [prefix+"robIdx_"+n for n in ("flag", "value")]
    for i in range(6):
        prefix = DISPATCH+f"io_enqRob_req_{i}_"
        names += [prefix+"valid"] + [prefix+"bits_"+n for n in ("instr", "pc", "robIdx_flag", "robIdx_value")]
    for i in range(8):
        names += [ROB+f"io_commits_commitValid_{i}"]
        names += [ROB+f"io_commits_robIdx_{i}_"+n for n in ("flag", "value")]
    for i in (1, 3, 5, 7):
        prefix = CTRL+f"io_fromWB_wbData_{i}_"
        names += [prefix+"valid", prefix+"bits_redirect_valid"]
        names += [prefix+"bits_redirect_bits_"+n for n in
                  ("robIdx_flag", "robIdx_value", "cfiUpdate_pc", "cfiUpdate_taken", "cfiUpdate_isMisPred")]
    return names

    scope, signals, values = [], {}, {}
    selected, live, records, flushes, decisions = set(), {}, [], [], {}
    writeback_redirects, accepted_redirects = [], []

    illegal_pc = symbols["control_exception_pc"]

    young_pcs = {symbols[n] for n in ("control_younger_dot", "control_younger_dot_v0", "control_younger_dot_alias")}
    wanted_pcs = set(symbols.values())
    serial, phase = 0, 0

    def get(name):
        value = values.get(signals[name])
        need(value is not None, f"unknown {name} at {time}")
        return value

    def tag(prefix):
        flag, value = get(prefix+"robIdx_flag"), get(prefix+"robIdx_value")
        need(flag in (0,1) and 0 <= value < ROB_SIZE, "invalid DefaultConfig ROB pointer")
        return flag * 256 + value

    def flush(origin, kind, level):
        event = dict(time=time, phase=phase, kind=kind, origin=origin, victims=[], settled=False)
        if kind == "branch":

            event["decision_time"] = decisions[origin]
            origin_rec = live.get(origin)

        for robtag, rec in list(live.items()):

            delta = (robtag-origin) % 512

                    rec["squashed_time"] = time

                # 保留已取消的相关标签以检查后续误提交，直到

                need(robtag % 256 < ROB_SIZE and 0 <= robtag < 512, "invalid commit ROB pointer")
                rec = live.get(robtag)

                    continue  # 窗口开始前的指令没有对应分派记录。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Resumable ISO v3 queue. Never rerun an audited completed slot or hide failure."""
import argparse
import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BASELINE = ROOT / 'stage3/logs/20261005T004545-274-series-full-runtime.paths'
EXPECTED = {
    'emu': 'd67519c61294dff5606d7f932a4545291dd5766828363710055279734932c054',
    'ref': '2ad56dc58975ed98748a7c76e014d8ac2a4576b327adbb6324f7f7082b25cb74',
    'full': '2adc73bbe4a0e01d183b93fc7a38613438b979af955ef8d2201904db6e0e1c24',
    'smoke': 'f351c87fe9f29cc1aafaca00c2f8f6c770288a894bfa92eed512985934a52ba5',
}


def module(name, filename):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / 'stage3/tests' / filename)
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value


bench = module('iso_bench', 'analyze-bench.py')
comparison = module('iso_comparison', 'compare-bench-cores.py')
renderer = module('iso_renderer', 'render-bench-report.py')


def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b''):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    # Only this queue's checkpoint is updated; evidence outputs use exclusive create.
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + '.tmp')
    with temporary.open('w') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write('\n')
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    temporary.replace(path)


def exclusive(path, text):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(text)


def check_frozen(state):
    for name, expected in state['frozen'].items():
        bench.need(digest(name) == expected, f'frozen artifact changed: {name}')
    print('[frozen PASS]', flush=True)


def validate_slot(slot):
    run = bench.audit(slot['log'])
    bench.need(run['meta']['schema'] == 3 and run['meta']['profile'] == slot['profile'],
               'wrong measurement schema/profile')
    bench.need(run['meta']['first'] == slot['index'] % 2, 'wrong counterbalanced order')
    for role in ('emu', 'ref'):
        bench.need(run['artifacts'][role] == EXPECTED[role], f'wrong {role} identity')
    bench.need(run['artifacts']['image'] == EXPECTED[slot['profile']], 'wrong frozen image')
    return run


def recover_pending(state, state_path):
    if not state.get('pending'):
        return
    pending = state['pending']
    bench.need(len(state['slots']) < 6, 'pending attempt after completed queue')
    expected = ([('smoke', i) for i in range(2)] + [('full', i) for i in range(4)])[len(state['slots'])]
    bench.need((pending['profile'], pending['index']) == expected, 'pending slot order changed')
    log = Path(pending['log'])
    text = log.read_text(errors='replace') if log.exists() else ''
    bench.need(not re.search(r'benchmark FAIL|HIT BAD TRAP|ABORT|different at pc', text),
               'failed attempt needs diagnosis, not an interrupted-run retry')
    if re.search(r'^\[process exit\]', text, re.M):
        run = validate_slot(pending)  # Recorded nonzero/data failure must stop.
        pending['log_sha256'] = run['log_sha256']
        state['slots'].append(pending)
        del state['pending']
    else:
        print(f'[interrupted attempt preserved] {log}', flush=True)
        state.setdefault('interrupted', []).append(state.pop('pending'))
    save(state_path, state)


def write_reports(state, prefix):
    smoke = [validate_slot(s) for s in state['slots'] if s['profile'] == 'smoke']
    full = [validate_slot(s) for s in state['slots'] if s['profile'] == 'full']
    bench.need(len(smoke) == 2 and len(full) == 4, 'incomplete queue')
    for profile in ('smoke', 'full'):
        manifest = prefix.with_name(prefix.name + f'-{profile}.paths')
        content = ''.join(s['summary'] + '\n' for s in state['slots'] if s['profile'] == profile)
        if manifest.exists():
            bench.need(manifest.read_text() == content, 'completed manifest changed')
        else:
            exclusive(manifest, content)
    full_manifest = prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '-full.paths')
    compared = comparison.compare(BASELINE, full_manifest)
    data = renderer.gather(full_manifest)
    report_path = ROOT / 'stage3/reports' / (prefix.name + '-performance.md')
    report = renderer.render(data, full_manifest, report_path)
    report = report.replace('# vdot 正式性能实测报告 v3', '# 隔离核 vdot 正式性能实测报告 v3', 1)
    report = report.replace('本轮未改 vdot RTL/NEMU，未做 oldVd 去依赖、门控、PPA；不据方法变化宣称硬件性能提升。',
        '本轮测量既有隔离核，包含P1 oldVd去依赖及操作数隔离/寄存器使能；测量期间没有修改RTL或NEMU。没有物理PPA结果，不据RTL活动计数宣称功耗收益。')
    report += '\n## P1 → 隔离核同协议对比\n\n'
    report += '| 内核 | vdot P1/隔离核周期比中位数 | RVV对照P1/隔离核 | first=0 | first=1 |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n'
    for kind, group in compared['groups'].items():
        report += (f"| {kind} | {group['vdot_gain']['median']:.6f} | "
                   f"{group['rvv_control']['median']:.6f} | {group['by_order']['0']:.6f} | "
                   f"{group['by_order']['1']:.6f} |\n")
    report += '\n比值>1表示隔离核该区间周期更少，<1表示更多；不与RVV/vdot内核比混淆。\n\n'
    report += '这是历史P1与当前隔离核的同顺序进程中位数对比，不是同步随机化试验。代码/镜像/ref/运行参数一致，保留双方所有原始样本及稳定性警告；不做样本筛选，不外推为FU延迟、应用或PPA收益。\n\n'
    report += 'P1稳定性警告：\n\n' + ('\n'.join('- ' + w for w in compared['before']['series']['warnings']) or '无。') + '\n'
    report += '\n## 队列恢复记录\n\n检查点：`' + prefix.name + '.state.json`。\n\n'
    report += ('\n'.join('- 基础设施中断尝试（没有完整退出记录，不算正式样本）：`' + s['log'] + '`'
                         for s in state.get('interrupted', [])) or '没有基础设施中断重跑。') + '\n'
    outputs = {
        prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '-smoke-audit.json'):
            json.dumps(dict(runs=smoke, series=bench.aggregate(smoke)), indent=2) + '\n',
        prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '-comparison.json'): json.dumps(compared, indent=2) + '\n',
        prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '-report.json'): json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n',
        report_path: report,
    }
    for path, content in outputs.items():
        if path.exists():
            bench.need(path.read_text() == content, f'refusing to alter existing evidence: {path}')
        else:
            exclusive(path, content)
    strict = 0 if data['series']['stable'] else 3
    print(f'[data/report PASS] strict_stability_exit={strict} report={report_path}', flush=True)
    return strict, report_path


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--resume', type=Path, help='exact existing queue .state.json')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    locks = []
    for name in ('isolation-performance.lock', 'benchmark-series.lock'):
        handle = (ROOT / 'stage3/logs' / name).open('a')
        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        locks.append(handle)
    emu = ROOT.parent / 'XiangShan/build/operand-isolation/emu'
    ref = ROOT.parent / 'NEMU/build/riscv64-nemu-interpreter-so'
    images = {p: ROOT / f'stage3/vdot-bench-p0/build/cie2026-stage3-vdot-bench-v3-{p}-riscv64-xs.bin'
              for p in ('smoke', 'full')}
    if args.resume:
        state_path = args.resume.resolve()
        bench.need(state_path.parent == ROOT / 'stage3/logs', 'checkpoint outside queue log directory')
        state = json.loads(state_path.read_text())
        prefix = ROOT / 'stage3/logs' / state['id']
        bench.need(re.fullmatch(r'\d{8}T\d{6}-\d+-isolation-perf', state['id']), 'invalid queue identity')
    else:
        queue_id = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') + f'-{os.getpid()}-isolation-perf'
        prefix = ROOT / 'stage3/logs' / queue_id
        state_path = prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '.state.json')
        bench.need(not state_path.exists(), 'queue collision')
        for name, expected in EXPECTED.items():
            path = emu if name == 'emu' else ref if name == 'ref' else images[name]
            bench.need(digest(path) == expected, f'preflight identity mismatch: {name}')
        baseline = comparison.gather(BASELINE)
        bench.need(baseline['runs'][0]['artifacts']['emu'] ==
                   'dfb6d9af4c84f490ae2b5ea9ab42553ee59860d980cc71fb82f9e8219c2176a5', 'not P1 baseline')
        subprocess.run(['sha256sum', '-c', 'build/operand-isolation/source-before.sha256'],
                       cwd=ROOT.parent / 'XiangShan', check=True)
        subprocess.run(['sha256sum', '-c', 'stage2/logs/20261006T021301-isolation-regression.sha256'], check=True)
        files = [emu, ref, BASELINE, Path(__file__).resolve(),
                 ROOT / 'stage3/reports/vdot-performance-p1.md']
        for run in baseline['runs']:
            files.append(Path(run['log']))
        files += list(images.values()) + [p.with_suffix('.elf') for p in images.values()]
        files += [ROOT / n for n in (
            'scripts/run-vdot-bench.sh', 'scripts/run-vdot-bench-series.sh',
            'stage3/tests/analyze-bench.py', 'stage3/tests/render-bench-report.py',
            'stage3/tests/compare-bench-cores.py', 'stage3/tests/prepare-runtime-order.py',
            'stage3/tests/test-isolation-performance.py',
            'stage3/vdot-bench-p0/main.c', 'stage3/vdot-bench-p0/bench.S',
            'stage3/vdot-bench-p0/Makefile', 'stage3/vdot-bench-p0/runtime-config.S',
            'stage3/vdot-bench/main.c', 'stage3/vdot-bench/bench.S',
            '../XiangShan/build/emu', '../XiangShan/build/p1-oldvd/emu',
            '../XiangShan/src/main/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/wrapper/VIMacU.scala',
            '../XiangShan/src/main/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8.scala',
            '../XiangShan/src/main/scala/xiangshan/backend/decode/DecodeUnitComp.scala')]
        state = dict(id=queue_id, frozen={str(p.resolve()): digest(p) for p in files}, slots=[],
                     status='RUNNING', note='two smoke then four full; first 0/1, all samples retained')
        save(state_path, state)
    print(f'[checkpoint] {state_path}', flush=True)
    check_frozen(state)
    plan = [('smoke', i) for i in range(2)] + [('full', i) for i in range(4)]
    bench.need(len(state['slots']) <= len(plan), 'invalid slot count')
    for slot, (profile, index) in zip(state['slots'], plan):
        bench.need((slot['profile'], slot['index']) == (profile, index), 'checkpoint order changed')
        validate_slot(slot)
        bench.need(digest(slot['log']) == slot['log_sha256'], 'completed log changed')
    recover_pending(state, state_path)
    for profile, index in plan[len(state['slots']):]:
        check_frozen(state)
        if profile == 'full' and index == 0:
            smoke_summary = bench.aggregate([validate_slot(s) for s in state['slots']])
            print('[two smoke data PASS] warnings=' + json.dumps(smoke_summary['warnings']), flush=True)
        attempt = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') + f'-{os.getpid()}'
        run_id = prefix.name + f'-{profile}-run{index}-{attempt}'
        summary = ROOT / 'stage3/logs' / (run_id + '-bench.log')
        log = summary.with_name(summary.name.replace('.log', '.full.log'))
        slot = dict(profile=profile, index=index, summary=str(summary), log=str(log))
        state['pending'] = slot
        save(state_path, state)
        env = dict(os.environ, VDOT_EMU=str(emu), VDOT_REF_SO=str(ref),
                   VDOT_IMAGE=str(images[profile]), VDOT_RUNTIME_ELF=str(images[profile].with_suffix('.elf')),
                   VDOT_RUNTIME_FIRST=str(index % 2), VDOT_BENCH_RUN_ID=run_id)
        env.pop('VDOT_BENCH_RESULT_FILE', None)
        env.pop('VDOT_BENCH_RUNNER_SNAPSHOT', None)
        env.pop('VDOT_BENCH_REPO_DIR', None)
        print(f'[slot start] {profile} {index} first={index % 2}', flush=True)
        subprocess.run(['bash', 'scripts/run-vdot-bench.sh'], env=env, check=True)
        run = validate_slot(slot)
        slot['log_sha256'] = run['log_sha256']
        state['slots'].append(slot)
        del state['pending']
        save(state_path, state)
        print(f'[slot PASS] {profile} {index} completed={len(state["slots"])}/6', flush=True)
    check_frozen(state)
    strict, report = write_reports(state, prefix)
    check_frozen(state)
    state.update(status='DATA_REPORT_PASS', strict_stability_exit=strict, report=str(report))
    save(state_path, state)
    with (ROOT / 'stage2/logs/operations.tsv').open('a') as stream:
        stream.write(f'{datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()}\tisolation-performance-strict-stability\t{strict}\t{state_path}\n')
    print(f'[queue PASS] {state_path}', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:

        state = dict(id=queue_id, frozen={str(p.resolve()): digest(p) for p in files}, slots=[],

        save(state_path, state)
    print(f'[checkpoint] {state_path}', flush=True)
    check_frozen(state)
    plan = [('smoke', i) for i in range(2)] + [('full', i) for i in range(4)]

    recover_pending(state, state_path)
    for profile, index in plan[len(state['slots']):]:

        run_id = prefix.name + f'-{profile}-run{index}-{attempt}'
        summary = ROOT / 'stage3/logs' / (run_id + '-bench.log')
        log = summary.with_name(summary.name.replace('.log', '.full.log'))
        slot = dict(profile=profile, index=index, summary=str(summary), log=str(log))
        state['pending'] = slot

        env.pop('VDOT_BENCH_RESULT_FILE', None)
        env.pop('VDOT_BENCH_RUNNER_SNAPSHOT', None)
        env.pop('VDOT_BENCH_REPO_DIR', None)
        print(f'[slot start] {profile} {index} first={index % 2}', flush=True)
        subprocess.run(['bash', 'scripts/run-vdot-bench.sh'], env=env, check=True)
        run = validate_slot(slot)
        slot['log_sha256'] = run['log_sha256']
        state['slots'].append(slot)
        del state['pending']
        save(state_path, state)
        print(f'[slot PASS] {profile} {index} completed={len(state["slots"])}/6', flush=True)
    check_frozen(state)
    strict, report = write_reports(state, prefix)
    check_frozen(state)
    state.update(status='DATA_REPORT_PASS', strict_stability_exit=strict, report=str(report))
    save(state_path, state)
    with (ROOT / 'stage2/logs/operations.tsv').open('a') as stream:
        stream.write(f'{datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()}\tisolation-performance-strict-stability\t{strict}\t{state_path}\n')
    print(f'[queue PASS] {state_path}', flush=True)

        raise SystemExit(f'isolation performance STOP: {error}')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Same-image runtime caller A/B; retain all 64 calls, not formal samples."""
import argparse
import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EMU = ROOT.parent / 'XiangShan/build/operand-isolation/emu'
REF = ROOT.parent / 'NEMU/build/riscv64-nemu-interpreter-so'

def sha(path):
    value=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1<<20),b''): value.update(block)
    return value.hexdigest()

def need(condition,message):
    if not condition: raise ValueError(message)

def prepare(elf,image,parameter,output):
    need(parameter in range(4),'invalid runtime parameter')
    symbols=subprocess.check_output(['riscv64-linux-gnu-nm',str(elf)],text=True)
    found=[int(x.split()[0],16) for x in symbols.splitlines()
           if x.split()[-1]=='bench_runtime_order']
    need(len(found)==1,'missing/duplicate runtime symbol')
    offset=found[0]-0x80000000
    original=image.read_bytes()
    need(0<=offset<min(len(original),0xf00) and original[offset]==0,'unsafe boot parameter')
    prefix=bytearray(original[:offset+1]); prefix[offset]=parameter
    changed=[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(original,prefix+original[len(prefix):])) if a!=b]
    need(changed==([offset] if parameter else []),'code/layout modified')
    with output.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(prefix)
    return dict(parameter=parameter,mode=parameter>>1,first=parameter&1,
                address=hex(found[0]),offset=offset,overwrite_nbytes=len(prefix),
                changed_offsets=changed,image_sha256=sha(image),overlay_sha256=sha(output))

def audit(path,batches,parameter):
    text=Path(path).read_text(errors='replace')
    need(not re.search(r'FAIL|HIT BAD TRAP|ABORT|different at pc',text),'recorded diagnostic failure')
    need(len(re.findall(r'^\[process exit\] 0$',text,re.M))==1,'missing/failed actual exit')
    need('Difftest enabled' in text and 'HIT GOOD TRAP' in text,'missing difftest/GOOD TRAP')
    need(text.count('e2e diag PASS:')==1,'missing/duplicate diagnostic PASS')
    metas=re.findall(r'e2e diag meta schema=1 mode=(\d+) first=(\d+) batches=(\d+) warmup=8 reps=8 directed=4',text)
    need(metas==[(str(parameter>>1),str(parameter&1),str(batches))],'wrong metadata')
    rows=re.findall(r'e2e diag raw kind=(\d+) round=(\d+) impl=(\d+) slot=(\d+) cycles=(\d+)',text)
    need(len(rows)==64 and text.count('e2e diag raw ')==64,'missing/duplicate/malformed raw records')
    values={}
    for k,r,i,slot,cycles in rows:
        k,r,i,slot,cycles=map(int,(k,r,i,slot,cycles))
        need(k in range(2) and r in range(16) and i in range(2) and slot in range(2),'invalid raw label')
        need(i==((parameter&1)^(r&1)^slot) and cycles>0,'wrong order/cycles')
        need((k,r,i) not in values,'duplicate call')
        values[k,r,i]=cycles
    groups={}
    for k in range(2):
        for i in range(2):
            warm=[values[k,r,i] for r in range(8)]
            measured=[values[k,r,i] for r in range(8,16)]
            median=statistics.median(measured)
            groups[f'{k}/{i}']=dict(warm=warm,measured=measured,median=median,
                warm_tail_drift=warm[-1]/median-1,
                cv=statistics.pstdev(measured)/statistics.mean(measured))
    return dict(mode=parameter>>1,first=parameter&1,batches=batches,groups=groups,
                raw_rows=rows,log=str(path),log_sha256=sha(path))

def write(path,value):
    with path.open('x') as stream: json.dump(value,stream,indent=2); stream.write('\n')

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--batches',type=int,choices=(32,256),required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    lock=(ROOT/'stage3/logs/e2e-diagnostic.lock').open('a')
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    # Validate the original frozen measurement before and after diagnostics.
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('iso',ROOT/'scripts/complete-vdot-isolation-performance.py')
    iso=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(iso)
    protected=json.loads((ROOT/'stage3/logs/20261006T060358-16-isolation-perf.state.json').read_text())
    iso.check_frozen(protected)
    stem=f'cie2026-e2e-diagnosis-b{args.batches}-riscv64-xs'
    image=ROOT/'stage3/e2e-diagnosis/build'/f'{stem}.bin'
    elf=image.with_suffix('.elf')
    inputs=[EMU,REF,image,elf,Path(__file__),ROOT/'stage3/vdot-bench/main.c',ROOT/'stage3/vdot-bench/bench.S']
    inputs+=[ROOT/'stage3/e2e-diagnosis'/name for name in ('Makefile','main.c','bench.S','runtime-config.S')]
    frozen={str(p):sha(p) for p in inputs}
    stamp=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')
    prefix=ROOT/'stage3/logs'/f'{stamp}-e2e-context-b{args.batches}'
    write(prefix.with_suffix('.inputs.json'),frozen)
    results=[]
    for parameter in range(4):
        need(all(sha(p)==h for p,h in frozen.items()),'diagnostic input changed')
        overlay=prefix.with_name(prefix.name+f'-p{parameter}.parameter.bin')
        record=prepare(elf,image,parameter,overlay)
        log=prefix.with_name(prefix.name+f'-p{parameter}.full.log')
        cmd=[str(EMU),f'--diff={REF}','-i',str(image),'--max-cycles=3000000','-b','0','-e','0',
             f'--gcpt-restore={overlay}',f'--overwrite-nbytes={record["overwrite_nbytes"]}']
        print(f'[diagnostic start] {datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()} p={parameter} batches={args.batches} log={log}',flush=True)
        with log.open('x') as stream:
            stream.write('[command] '+json.dumps(cmd)+'\n[parameter] '+json.dumps(record)+'\n[inputs] '+json.dumps(frozen)+'\n')
            stream.flush()
            status=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,cwd=ROOT.parent).returncode
            stream.write(f'\n[process exit] {status}\n')
        result=audit(log,args.batches,parameter)
        result['runtime_parameter']=record
        results.append(result)
        write(prefix.with_name(prefix.name+f'-p{parameter}.audit.json'),result)
        print('[diagnostic PASS] '+json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ('mode','first','batches','groups','log','log_sha256')},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
    need(all(sha(p)==h for p,h in frozen.items()),'diagnostic input changed at end')
    iso.check_frozen(protected)
    write(prefix.with_suffix('.results.json'),dict(runs=results,frozen=frozen,
          caveat='Diagnostic caller intervention, different layout/preconditioning from historic formal binary. Association is not a cache/branch/LSQ root cause. No sample removed.'))
    print(f'[diagnostic suite PASS] {prefix}.results.json',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__': main()

def main():

    base=json.loads((BUILD/'complete.json').read_text())
    assert base['status']=='PASS' and sha(BUILD/'emu')==base['emu_sha256']
    shutil.copy2(BUILD/'emu',BUILD/'emu-initial-collector')
    fields=BUILD/'emulator/event_fields.h';text=fields.read_text()
    model=(BUILD/'emu-compile/VSimTop___024root.h').read_text()
    parent='SimTop__DOT__l_soc__DOT__core_with_l2__DOT__core__DOT__backend__DOT__inner_ctrlBlock__DOT__dispatch__DOT__'
    observed=json.loads((BUILD/'observed-fields.json').read_text())
    for i in range(6):
        v=parent+f'io_enqRob_req_{i}_valid'

    (BUILD/'final.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
    print('[event observer FINAL]',json.dumps(result),flush=True)

  snapshot_dir="$(mktemp -d "$repo_dir/stage3/logs/series-snapshot.XXXXXX")"

  exec env VDOT_BENCH_SERIES_SNAPSHOT=1 VDOT_BENCH_REPO_DIR="$repo_dir" \
    bash "$snapshot_dir/series.sh" "$@"
fi
profile=full

for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --smoke) profile=smoke ;;
    --runtime-order) runtime_order=1 ;;
    --runs=*) runs="${arg#--runs=}" ;;
    --help) echo 'usage: run-vdot-bench-series.sh [--runtime-order] [--smoke] [--runs=EVEN_NUMBER]'; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "unknown option: $arg"; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

  runs=4
  [[ "$profile" == smoke ]] && runs=2
fi
[[ "$runs" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || { echo 'invalid run count'; exit 2; }
minimum=4
[[ "$profile" == smoke ]] && minimum=2
(( runs >= minimum && runs % 2 == 0 )) || { echo 'need balanced runs (full>=4, smoke>=2)'; exit 2; }
mkdir -p "$repo_dir/stage3/logs" "$repo_dir/stage2/logs"
exec 9>"$repo_dir/stage3/logs/benchmark-series.lock"
flock -n 9 || { echo 'another benchmark series is active'; exit 2; }
series="$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$-series-$profile"
if (( runtime_order )); then series="$series-runtime"; fi
manifest="$repo_dir/stage3/logs/$series.paths"
test ! -e "$manifest"
touch "$manifest"
trap 'series_status=$?; printf "[series exit] %s status=%s manifest=%s\n" "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" "$series_status" "$manifest"' EXIT
for (( run=0; run<runs; run++ )); do
  first=$(( run % 2 ))
  image="$repo_dir/stage3/vdot-bench/build/cie2026-stage3-vdot-bench-v2-$profile-order$first-riscv64-xs.bin"

    export VDOT_RUNTIME_FIRST="$first" VDOT_RUNTIME_ELF="${image%.bin}.elf"
  fi
  test -f "$image" || { echo "build both $profile order images first"; exit 2; }
  echo "[series run] $run/$runs first=$first profile=$profile"
  VDOT_IMAGE="$image" VDOT_BENCH_RUN_ID="$series-run$run" VDOT_BENCH_RESULT_FILE="$manifest" \
    bash "$repo_dir/scripts/run-vdot-bench.sh"
done

python3 "$repo_dir/stage3/tests/analyze-bench.py" "${summaries[@]}" \

echo '[series data PASS] Stability warnings do not constitute a stable-performance claim.'

# records rising-only snapshots, so normalize it BEFORE logging/execution.

  if [[ "$control_arg" == --dump-wave ]]; then control_args+=(--dump-wave-full)
  else control_args+=("$control_arg"); fi

  printf '[started] %s\n' "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
  printf '[command] %q --diff=%q -i %q --max-cycles=10000000 ' "$emu" "$ref" "$image"
  printf '%q ' "$@"; printf '\n'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local-only Surver service, with a browser-compatible loopback proxy."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import http.client
import http.server
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LOCAL = ROOT / 'private/surver'
RUN = LOCAL / 'run'
BINARY = LOCAL / 'bin/surver'
UNIT = 'vdot-surver.service'
DEFAULT_WAVE = ROOT / 'stage3/logs/p1-before-20261004.vcd'
SMOKE_WAVE = ROOT / 'stage2/waveform/isolation/VDot8-final.vcd'
EXPECTED_BINARY = '5a6028c5d476c5db65d5eafbc490f385daa22d6ba65ffb82772e0590b1ea719e'


def config():
    return json.loads((RUN / 'config.json').read_text())


def base_url(cfg):
    token = (RUN / 'token').read_text().strip()
    return f'http://127.0.0.1:{cfg["port"]}/{token}'


def request(cfg, suffix):
    req = urllib.request.Request(base_url(cfg) + suffix,
        headers={'Origin': 'https://local-test.vscode-cdn.net'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
        return response.status, dict(response.headers), response.read()


def start(args):
    wave = (args.wave or (SMOKE_WAVE if args.smoke else DEFAULT_WAVE)).resolve(strict=True)
    if not wave.is_relative_to(ROOT) or wave.suffix.lower() not in ('.vcd', '.fst', '.ghw'):
        raise ValueError('wave must be an existing waveform within the project')
    if not 1024 <= args.port <= 65534:
        raise ValueError('port must be 1024..65534; port+1 is reserved for backend')
    if hashlib.sha256(BINARY.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != EXPECTED_BINARY:
        raise ValueError('Surver binary identity changed')
    # Refuse duplicate service or overwriting the active connection configuration.
    if subprocess.run(['systemctl', '--user', 'is-active', '--quiet', UNIT]).returncode == 0:
        raise ValueError('service is already active; stop it before switching waves')
    subprocess.run(['systemctl', '--user', 'reset-failed', UNIT],
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    for port in (args.port, args.port + 1):
        with socket.socket() as probe:
            probe.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
            probe.bind(('127.0.0.1', port))
    RUN.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    RUN.chmod(0o700)
    os.umask(0o077)
    cfg = {'wave': str(wave), 'port': args.port, 'backend_port': args.port + 1,
           'bytes': wave.stat().st_size, 'bind': '127.0.0.1', 'unit': UNIT}
    (RUN / 'token').write_text(secrets.token_urlsafe(32) + '\n')
    (RUN / 'config.json').write_text(json.dumps(cfg, indent=2) + '\n')
    (RUN / 'connection.txt').write_text(base_url(cfg) + '\n')
    subprocess.run(['systemd-run', '--user', '--unit=' + UNIT, '--collect',
        '--service-type=exec', '--property=Restart=no', '--property=MemoryHigh=2G',
        '--property=MemoryMax=4G', '--property=MemorySwapMax=2G',
        '--property=TasksMax=128', '--property=UMask=0077',
        '--property=WorkingDirectory=' + str(ROOT),
        '--property=StandardOutput=append:' + str(RUN / 'service.log'),
        '--property=StandardError=append:' + str(RUN / 'service.log'),
        '/usr/bin/python3', str(Path(__file__).resolve()), 'serve'], check=True)
    print('Started local-only service. Connection URL is in private/surver/run/connection.txt')
    print('Wave:', wave)


def serve():
    cfg = config()
    token = (RUN / 'token').read_text().strip()
    os.umask(0o077)
    with (RUN / 'backend.log').open('a', buffering=1) as log:
        backend = subprocess.Popen([str(BINARY), '--bind-address', '127.0.0.1',
            '--port', str(cfg['backend_port']), '--token', token, cfg['wave']],
            stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            env={**os.environ, 'RAYON_NUM_THREADS': '2'})
        slots = threading.BoundedSemaphore(8)

        class Proxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def version_string(self):
                # Surfer uses this header to identify its remote protocol.
                return 'Surfer'

            def log_message(self, *_args):
                pass  # URLs contain credentials; never write request paths to logs.

            def cors(self):
                # Only random-token-authorized paths are forwarded, no cookie auth.
                self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
                self.send_header('Access-Control-Expose-Headers',
                    'Server, x-wellen-version, x-surfer-version, Content-Type')
                self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, OPTIONS')
                self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type')
                self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')

            def do_OPTIONS(self):
                self.send_response(204)
                self.cors()
                self.end_headers()

            def do_GET(self):
                if self.path != '/' + token and not self.path.startswith('/' + token + '/'):
                    self.send_response(404)
                    self.cors()
                    self.end_headers()
                    return
                if not slots.acquire(blocking=False):
                    self.send_response(503)
                    self.end_headers()
                    return
                connection = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', cfg['backend_port'], timeout=120)
                try:
                    connection.request('GET', self.path)
                    response = connection.getresponse()
                    self.send_response(response.status)
                    for name, value in response.getheaders():
                        if name.lower() in ('content-type', 'content-length',
                                            'x-wellen-version', 'x-surfer-version'):
                            self.send_header(name, value)
                    self.cors()
                    self.end_headers()
                    while chunk := response.read(65536):
                        self.wfile.write(chunk)
                except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError, OSError):
                    self.close_connection = True
                finally:
                    connection.close()
                    slots.release()

        server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', cfg['port']), Proxy)
        server.daemon_threads = True
        def terminate(_signum, _frame):
            raise SystemExit(0)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, terminate)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, terminate)
        def watch():
            result = backend.wait()
            print('Surver backend exited:', result, flush=True)
            os._exit(result or 1)
        threading.Thread(target=watch, daemon=True).start()
        print(f'Browser proxy listening at 127.0.0.1:{cfg["port"]}; backend loopback only', flush=True)
        try:
            server.serve_forever()
        finally:
            server.server_close()
            if backend.poll() is None:
                backend.terminate()
                backend.wait(timeout=10)


def status():
    cfg = config()
    _, headers, body = request(cfg, '/get_status')
    data = json.loads(body)
    assert headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin') == '*'
    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))


def check():
    cfg = config()
    _, _, body = request(cfg, '/get_status')
    state = json.loads(body)
    assert len(state['file_infos']) == 1
    info = state['file_infos'][0]
    assert info['filename'] == cfg['wave'] and info['last_load_ok']
    # Wellen's buffered progress can overshoot its estimated body length.
    # Surver sets last_modification_time only after the body parser succeeds.
    assert info['last_modification_time'] is not None and not info['reloading'], 'body is still loading'
    results = {}
    for endpoint in ('get_hierarchy', 'get_time_table', 'get_signals/0'):
        code, headers, data = request(cfg, '/0/' + endpoint)
        assert code == 200 and data
        assert 'Surfer' in headers.get('Server', '')
        assert headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin') == '*'
        assert headers.get('x-wellen-version') == state['wellen_version']
        results[endpoint] = len(data)
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{cfg["port"]}/invalid-token/get_status', timeout=5)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
        assert err.code == 404
    else:
        raise AssertionError('invalid token was accepted')
    print(json.dumps({'status': 'PASS', 'wave': cfg['wave'], 'version': state['surfer_version'],
        'wellen_version': state['wellen_version'], 'transferred_bytes': results,
        'invalid_token': 'rejected', 'browser_CORS': 'PASS'}, indent=2))


def windows_check():
    # URL/token goes through stdin, not command arguments or public diagnostics.
    command = '''$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$url = [Console]::In.ReadLine()
$r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ($url + "/get_status") -TimeoutSec 30
$data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
[PSCustomObject]@{http_status=$r.StatusCode; surfer_version=$data.surfer_version; wellen_version=$data.wellen_version; file_count=$data.file_infos.Count; last_load_ok=$data.file_infos[0].last_load_ok} | ConvertTo-Json
'''
    result = subprocess.run(['powershell.exe', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', command],
        input=base_url(config()) + '\n', text=True, encoding='utf-8',
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=45)
    if result.returncode:
        # Never echo stderr, which can include the credential-bearing request URL.
        raise RuntimeError('Windows localhost probe failed; inspect connection/port forwarding without publishing token')
    data = json.loads(result.stdout.lstrip('\ufeff'))
    assert data['http_status'] == 200 and data['file_count'] == 1 and data['last_load_ok']
    print(json.dumps({'Windows_to_WSL': 'PASS', **data}, indent=2))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('action', choices=('start', 'stop', 'status', 'check', 'windows-check', 'url', 'serve'))
    parser.add_argument('--wave', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--smoke', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=8911)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.action == 'start':
        start(args)
    elif args.action == 'stop':
        subprocess.run(['systemctl', '--user', 'stop', UNIT], check=True)
    elif args.action == 'status':
        status()
    elif args.action == 'check':
        check()
    elif args.action == 'windows-check':
        windows_check()
    elif args.action == 'url':
        print(base_url(config()))
    else:
        serve()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
