#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit legacy/v2 logs; variation and run-level statistics, not FU latency."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import statistics
from pathlib import Path

KINDS = ("batch4", "e2e", "chain")
IMPLS = ("vdot", "rvv")


def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def distribution(values):
    mean, median = statistics.mean(values), statistics.median(values)
    return dict(n=len(values), median=median, min=min(values), max=max(values),
                mean=mean, cv=statistics.pstdev(values) / mean,
                relative_range=(max(values) - min(values)) / median)


def audit(path, max_cv=0.05, max_drift=0.10):
    path = Path(path)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]", "", raw.decode(errors="replace"))
    need("Difftest enabled" in text and "HIT GOOD TRAP" in text, "missing difftest/GOOD TRAP")
    need("vdot benchmark PASS:" in text, "missing benchmark PASS")
    need(not re.search(r"HIT BAD TRAP|ABORT|different at pc|bench[^\r\n]*FAIL", text), "failure marker")
    need(not re.search(r"\[(?:process |verification )?exit\]\s+[1-9]\d*", text), "nonzero exit")
    eq = re.findall(r"bench equivalence PASS: vectors=(\d+) checks=(\d+) policies=4 baseline=vwmul\+vwredsum vdot=(\d+)", text)
    need(len(eq) == 1 and eq[0][2] == "1", "need one BOTH-implementation equivalence PASS")
    metas = re.findall(r"bench meta ([^\r\n]+)", text)
    if metas:
        need(len(metas) == 1, "duplicate metadata")
        need(re.findall(r"\[process exit\]\s+(\d+)", text) == ["0"], "v2 requires one recorded zero process exit")
        pairs = re.findall(r"(\w+)=(\S+)", metas[0])
        meta = dict(pairs)
        required = {"schema", "profile", "reps", "warmup", "batches", "random", "first", "deferred", "seed", "timing"}
        need(len(meta) == len(pairs) and set(meta) == required, "duplicate/unknown/missing metadata")
        need(meta["schema"] in ("2", "3") and meta["deferred"] == "1" and meta["timing"] in ("mcycle_raw", "mcycle_vstart_serialized"), "unsupported protocol")
        need(meta["profile"] in ("full", "smoke") and meta["seed"] == "56444f54", "unknown profile/seed")
        for key in ("schema", "reps", "warmup", "batches", "random", "first", "deferred"):
            meta[key] = int(meta[key])
        need(meta["reps"] >= 2 and meta["reps"] % 2 == 0, "unbalanced repetitions")
        need(meta["warmup"] >= 2 and meta["warmup"] % 2 == 0, "unbalanced warmup")
        need(0 < meta["batches"] <= 65536 and meta["random"] >= 0 and meta["first"] in (0, 1), "invalid configuration")
        if meta["profile"] == "full":
            need(meta["timing"] == "mcycle_vstart_serialized", "full profile needs serialized timestamps")
            need(meta["random"] >= 1000 and meta["reps"] >= 8 and meta["warmup"] >= 8 and meta["batches"] >= 256, "full profile below acceptance floor")
        need(tuple(map(int, eq[0][:2])) == (8 + meta["random"], 32 + meta["random"]), "equivalence counts mismatch")
    else:
        need(tuple(map(int, eq[0][:2])) == (1008, 1032), "legacy equivalence counts")
        meta = dict(schema=1, profile="legacy", reps=5, warmup=1, batches=32, random=1000, first=0, deferred=0)
    rows = re.findall(r"bench raw kind=(batch4|e2e|chain) impl=(rvv|vdot) rep=(\d+)(?: slot=(\d+))? dots=(\d+) cycles=(\d+)", text)
    empty = re.findall(r"bench raw kind=empty impl=control rep=(\d+) loops=(\d+) cycles=(\d+)", text)
    need(text.count("bench raw ") == len(rows) + len(empty), "malformed/unknown raw record")
    values = {(k, i): {} for k in KINDS for i in IMPLS}
    for kind, impl, rep, slot, dots, cycles in rows:
        rep, dots, cycles = int(rep), int(dots), int(cycles)
        need(rep not in values[kind, impl], "duplicate repetition")
        need(dots == 4 * meta["batches"] and cycles > 0, "wrong dot count/nonpositive cycles")
        values[kind, impl][rep] = cycles
        if meta["schema"] >= 2:
            need(slot in ("0", "1"), "missing/invalid slot")
            need(impl == IMPLS[meta["first"] ^ (rep & 1) ^ int(slot)], "pair order mismatch")
        else:
            need(slot == "", "v2 rows without metadata")
    expected_reps = set(range(meta["reps"]))
    for key in values:
        need(set(values[key]) == expected_reps, f"missing/out-of-range repetitions: {key}")
    if meta["schema"] >= 2:
        expected_rows = [(k, IMPLS[meta["first"] ^ (rep & 1) ^ slot], str(rep), str(slot))
                         for k in KINDS for rep in range(meta["reps"]) for slot in range(2)]
        need([r[:4] for r in rows] == expected_rows, "record execution order mismatch")
        warms = re.findall(r"bench warm kind=(batch4|e2e|chain) impl=(rvv|vdot) count=(\d+) first_cycles=(\d+) last_cycles=(\d+)", text)
        need(len(warms) == 6 and text.count("bench warm ") == 6, "missing/malformed warmup summaries")
        need({(w[0], w[1]) for w in warms} == set(values), "duplicate/missing warmup group")
        need(all(int(w[2]) == meta["warmup"] and int(w[3]) > 0 and int(w[4]) > 0 for w in warms), "invalid warmup summary")
    empty_values = {}
    for rep, loops, cycles in empty:
        rep, loops, cycles = int(rep), int(loops), int(cycles)
        need(rep not in empty_values and loops == meta["batches"] and cycles > 0, "invalid/duplicate empty control")
        empty_values[rep] = cycles
    need(set(empty_values) == expected_reps, "missing empty repetitions")
    groups, warnings = {}, []
    if meta.get("timing") != "mcycle_vstart_serialized":
        warnings.append("legacy/raw timestamp boundary is not serialized; do not claim complete-operation latency")
    for kind in KINDS:
        groups[kind] = {}
        for impl in IMPLS:
            vals = [values[kind, impl][r] for r in range(meta["reps"])]
            stats = distribution(vals)
            split = len(vals) // 2
            stats["half_drift"] = statistics.median(vals[split:]) / statistics.median(vals[:split]) - 1
            stats["cycles_per_dot"] = stats["median"] / (4 * meta["batches"])
            stats["raw"] = vals
            if meta["schema"] >= 2:
                first_vals = [v for r, v in enumerate(vals) if IMPLS[meta["first"] ^ (r & 1)] == impl]
                second_vals = [v for r, v in enumerate(vals) if IMPLS[meta["first"] ^ (r & 1)] != impl]
                stats["slot_effect"] = statistics.median(first_vals) / statistics.median(second_vals) - 1
                warm = next(w for w in warms if w[:2] == (kind, impl))
                stats["warm_tail_drift"] = int(warm[4]) / stats["median"] - 1
            if (stats["cv"] > max_cv or abs(stats["half_drift"]) > max_drift
                    or abs(stats.get("slot_effect", 0)) > max_drift
                    or abs(stats.get("warm_tail_drift", 0)) > max_drift):
                warnings.append(f"{kind}/{impl}: variation, warm-tail/half drift or slot effect exceeds threshold")
            groups[kind][impl] = stats
        groups[kind]["raw_speedup"] = groups[kind]["rvv"]["median"] / groups[kind]["vdot"]["median"]
        groups[kind]["paired_speedups"] = [values[kind, "rvv"][r] / values[kind, "vdot"][r] for r in range(meta["reps"])]
    identities = {}
    for role in ("emu", "ref", "image"):
        matches = re.findall(rf"\[artifact {role}\] ([0-9a-f]{{64}})", text)
        need(len(matches) <= 1, "duplicate artifact identity")
        if matches:
            identities[role] = matches[0]
    runtime = None
    if meta["schema"] == 3:
        records = re.findall(r"^\[runtime parameter\] (.+)$", text, re.M)
        need(len(records) == 1, "schema3 needs one audited runtime parameter")
        runtime = json.loads(records[0])
        need(runtime["first"] == meta["first"] and runtime["image_sha256"] == identities.get("image"), "runtime/image/order mismatch")
        need(0 <= runtime["offset"] < 0xf00 and runtime["overwrite_nbytes"] == runtime["offset"] + 1, "invalid parameter range")
        need(runtime["changed_offsets"] == ([runtime["offset"]] if meta["first"] else []), "non-parameter byte changed")
        need(runtime["parameter_address"] == hex(0x80000000 + runtime["offset"]) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", runtime["overlay_sha256"]), "invalid runtime identity")
    return dict(log=str(path.resolve()), log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), meta=meta,
                artifacts=identities, groups=groups,
                warmup_summaries=warms if meta["schema"] >= 2 else [],
                runtime_parameter=runtime,
                empty=distribution(list(empty_values.values())),
                warnings=warnings, stable=not warnings,
                qualification="smoke is flow validation only; raw guest cycles, NOT isolated latency/PPA")


def aggregate(runs, max_cv=0.05, max_drift=0.10):
    need(len({r["log"] for r in runs}) == len(runs), "repeated log path")
    need(len({r["log_sha256"] for r in runs}) == len(runs), "duplicate log content")
    meta = runs[0]["meta"]
    need(meta["schema"] in (2, 3) and len(runs) >= (4 if meta["profile"] == "full" else 2) and len(runs) % 2 == 0, "need balanced fresh runs (full>=4, smoke>=2)")
    config = {k: v for k, v in meta.items() if k != "first"}

def distribution(values):
    mean, median = statistics.mean(values), statistics.median(values)

import argparse
import re
import subprocess

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("elf")
args = parser.parse_args()
text = subprocess.check_output(["riscv64-linux-gnu-objdump", "-d", args.elf], text=True)


def body(name):
    match = re.search(rf"^[0-9a-f]+ <{name}>:\n(.*?)(?=^[0-9a-f]+ <|\Z)", text, re.M | re.S)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"missing {name}")
    return match[1]


kernel, empty = body("bench_kernel"), body("bench_empty")
start = r"csrwi\s+vstart,0\n[^\n]*csrr\s+t1,mcycle\n[^\n]*csrwi\s+vstart,0"
end = r"csrwi\s+vstart,0\n[^\n]*csrr\s+t3,mcycle"
if len(re.findall(start, kernel)) != 4 or len(re.findall(end, kernel)) != 1:
    raise ValueError("kernel timer markers missing/misordered")
if len(re.findall(start, empty)) != 1 or len(re.findall(end, empty)) != 1:
    raise ValueError("empty control timer markers missing/misordered")
if not re.search(r"mv\s+t0,a5", kernel):
    raise ValueError("batch count is not passed through a5")
if re.search(r"\b(?:jal|jalr)\b", kernel + empty):
    raise ValueError("unexpected function call in timed kernels")
print("benchmark binary audit PASS: runtime batches, symmetric CSR-write timer markers, no function calls")
print("Static evidence only; no isolated FU latency or dynamic ROB-order proof")

         "oldvd probe PASS: 48 calls" in text, "missing full-core PASS")

                boundary="CSR dispatch drain/block and timestamp output order; NOT DRAM store durability, wrong-path proof or PPA")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

"""Compare separately audited four-process v3 series; retain all samples/warnings."""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import statistics
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bench', Path(__file__).with_name('analyze-bench.py'))
bench = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(bench)


def gather(manifest):
    paths = [Path(line) for line in Path(manifest).read_text().splitlines() if line]
    bench.need(len(paths) == 4, 'need exactly four independent processes per core')
    bench.need(all(p.name.endswith('-bench.log') for p in paths), 'invalid summary manifest')
    runs = [bench.audit(p.with_name(p.stem + '.full.log')) for p in paths]
    summary = bench.aggregate(runs)
    bench.need(all(r['meta']['schema'] == 3 and r['meta']['profile'] == 'full' for r in runs),
               'core comparison requires original v3 full protocol')
    bench.need([r['meta']['first'] for r in runs] == [0,1,0,1], 'unexpected counterbalanced order')
    return dict(runs=runs, series=summary)


def compare(before_manifest, after_manifest):
    before, after = gather(before_manifest), gather(after_manifest)
    for old, new in zip(before['runs'], after['runs']):
        bench.need(old['meta'] == new['meta'], 'measurement configuration changed')
        bench.need(all(old['artifacts'][r] == new['artifacts'][r] for r in ('ref','image')),
                   'reference model or v3 image changed')
        bench.need(old['runtime_parameter'] == new['runtime_parameter'], 'runtime overlay changed')
    bench.need(before['runs'][0]['artifacts']['emu'] != after['runs'][0]['artifacts']['emu'],
               'old/new cores have identical artifact identity')
    groups = {}
    for kind in bench.KINDS:
        pairs = []
        for index, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(before['runs'], after['runs'])):
            med = {f'{side}_{impl}': r['groups'][kind][impl]['median']
                   for side,r in [('before',old),('after',new)] for impl in bench.IMPLS}
            pairs.append(dict(run=index, first=old['meta']['first'], **med,
                              vdot_old_over_new=med['before_vdot']/med['after_vdot'],
                              rvv_control_old_over_new=med['before_rvv']/med['after_rvv']))
        groups[kind] = dict(pairs=pairs,
                           vdot_gain=bench.distribution([p['vdot_old_over_new'] for p in pairs]),
                           rvv_control=bench.distribution([p['rvv_control_old_over_new'] for p in pairs]),
                           by_order={str(first): statistics.median(p['vdot_old_over_new'] for p in pairs
                                                                   if p['first']==first) for first in (0,1)})
    return dict(status='PASS', before=before, after=after, groups=groups,
                thresholds=dict(cv=0.05, drift=0.10),
                caveat='Chronological same-order run-median comparisons, not simultaneous randomized core trials. All raw samples and both stability warnings retained; RVV is an unadjusted control. Whole guest intervals, NOT isolated FU latency, PPA or application speedup.')


if __name__ == '__main__':

"""Generate an audited boot parameter overlay; no recompilation/code changes."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def prepare(elf, image, first, output):
    if first not in (0, 1):
        raise ValueError("order must be 0 or 1")
    symbols = subprocess.check_output(["riscv64-linux-gnu-nm", str(elf)], text=True)
    found = [int(line.split()[0], 16) for line in symbols.splitlines()
             if line.split()[-1] == "bench_runtime_order"]
    if len(found) != 1:
        raise ValueError("need exactly one runtime parameter symbol")
    offset = found[0] - 0x80000000
    original = Path(image).read_bytes()
    if not 0 <= offset < min(len(original), 0xf00) or original[offset] != 0:
        raise ValueError("parameter must be initialized zero in supported boot prefix")
    overlay = bytearray(original[:offset + 1])
    overlay[offset] = first
    reconstructed = overlay + original[len(overlay):]
    changes = [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(original, reconstructed)) if a != b]
    if changes != ([offset] if first else []):
        raise ValueError("unexpected executable/layout change")
    record = dict(first=first, parameter_address=hex(found[0]), offset=offset,
                  overwrite_nbytes=len(overlay), changed_offsets=changes,
                  image_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),
                  overlay_sha256=hashlib.sha256(overlay).hexdigest())
    with Path(output).open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(overlay)
    return record


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("elf")
    parser.add_argument("image")
    parser.add_argument("first", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("output")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        print(json.dumps(prepare(args.elf, args.image, args.first, args.output), sort_keys=True))
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
        parser.exit(1, f"runtime parameter FAIL: {error}\n")

"""Re-audit every completed full log and render Markdown without sample selection."""
import argparse

from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

def gather(manifest):
    entries = [Path(p) for p in Path(manifest).read_text().splitlines() if p]
    bench.need(len(entries) >= 4, "need at least four completed full processes")
    bench.need(all(p.name.endswith("-bench.log") for p in entries), "unexpected manifest entry")
    logs = [p.with_name(p.name.removesuffix(".log") + ".full.log") for p in entries]
    runs = [bench.audit(p) for p in logs]
    bench.need(all(r["meta"]["profile"] == "full" for r in runs), "smoke is not formal performance")
    return dict(runs=runs, series=bench.aggregate(runs), thresholds=dict(cv=0.05, drift=0.10))

def vadd_records(text):
    inputs = re.findall(r'EXEC cycle=(\d+).*ready=1.*src0_lane0=(-?\d+) src1_lane0=(-?\d+)', text)
    outputs = re.findall(r'WB\s+cycle=(\d+) channel=(\d+) result_lane0=(-?\d+)', text)
    need(len(inputs) == len(outputs) == 10 and 'execution_count=10 writeback_count=10' in text,
         'incomplete vadd audit')
    result = []
    for (start, a, b), (end, channel, value) in zip(inputs, outputs):
        start, a, b, end, channel, value = map(int, (start, a, b, end, channel, value))
        need(end-start == 2 and a+b == value, 'vadd data/time mismatch')
        result.append(dict(start=start, end=end, a=a, b=b, channel=channel, value=value))
    return result

         'missing original execution/commit audit')

    rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO('time,hierarchy,rob_flag,rob_index,pdest,v0_wen,result_128\n'+'\n'.join(lines))))
    need(len(rows) == 29, 'incomplete dot records')

         'missing signed/extreme coverage')

    need(data['architectural_status'] == data['control_status'] == 'PASS'
         and data['coverage_required'], 'incomplete core control audit')
    by_index = {r['index']: r for r in data['records']}
    selected = []
    for kind, count in [('branch', 2), ('exception', 4)]:
        flushes = data['proof'][kind]
        need(len(flushes) == count, 'wrong actual flush coverage')
        for event in flushes:
            need(event['settled'], 'unsettled flush')

    def __init__(self, title, subtitle):

                      '<rect width="1560" height="1110" fill="#f4f7fb"/>',

    def dot(self,x,y,color='#175cd3',label=None):

        self.parts.append(f'<rect x="24" y="{y}" width="1512" height="{height}" rx="10" fill="white" stroke="#d5dfeb"/>')

def need(value, message):
    if not value:

def vadd_records(text):
    inputs = re.findall(r'EXEC cycle=(\d+).*ready=1.*src0_lane0=(-?\d+) src1_lane0=(-?\d+)', text)
    outputs = re.findall(r'WB\s+cycle=(\d+) channel=(\d+) result_lane0=(-?\d+)', text)
    need(len(inputs) == len(outputs) == 10 and 'execution_count=10 writeback_count=10' in text,
         'incomplete vadd audit')
    result = []
    for (start, a, b), (end, channel, value) in zip(inputs, outputs):
        start, a, b, end, channel, value = map(int, (start, a, b, end, channel, value))
        need(end-start == 2 and a+b == value, 'vadd data/time mismatch')
        result.append(dict(start=start, end=end, a=a, b=b, channel=channel, value=value))
    return result


def dot_records(text):
    need('execution_observations=29 vdot_commits=29' in text and '[exit] 0' in text,
         'missing original execution/commit audit')

    rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO('time,hierarchy,rob_flag,rob_index,pdest,v0_wen,result_128\n'+'\n'.join(lines))))
    need(len(rows) == 29, 'incomplete dot records')
    result = []
    for row in rows:
        value = int(row['result_128'], 16)
        need(0 <= value < 2**32, 'upper96 not zero')
        result.append(dict(time=int(row['time']), tag=f"{row['rob_flag']}:{row['rob_index']}",
                           value=value, signed=value if value < 2**31 else value-2**32))

         'missing signed/extreme coverage')

    need(data['architectural_status'] == data['control_status'] == 'PASS'
         and data['coverage_required'], 'incomplete core control audit')

    selected = []
    for kind, count in [('branch', 2), ('exception', 4)]:
        flushes = data['proof'][kind]

        for event in flushes:
            need(event['settled'], 'unsettled flush')

            need(len(victims) == (2 if kind == 'branch' else 3), 'missing victims')
            for r in victims:
                need('commit_time' not in r and r['dispatch_time'] < r['execution_time'] < event['time']
                     and r['squashed_time'] == event['time'] and r['squash_kind'] == kind,
                     'victim execution/cancellation mismatch')
        event = flushes[0]  # 按时间选择首个满足条件的记录，不选择延迟最小的记录。

SVG is canonical; PNG is rendered with the system librsvg/Cairo libraries.
"""
import argparse
import ctypes
import hashlib
import html
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('oldvd_audit', Path(__file__).with_name('check-oldvd-wave.py'))
audit = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(audit)
DEFAULT_OUTPUT = ROOT / 'stage3/reports/figures/p1'
SOURCES = {
    'before': ('stage3/logs/p1-before-20261004.vcd', 'stage3/logs/p1-before-wave-source-audit.json'),
    'after': ('stage3/logs/20261004T232857-17-p1-after.vcd', 'stage3/logs/20261004T232857-17-p1-after-wave-audit.json'),
}


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def choose(before, after):
    cases = [
        ('oldvd', 'Independent destination: oldVd false dependency',
         lambda r: r['vd'] == 10 and r['vd'] not in (r['vs1'], r['vs2'])
         and r['example'] is not None and r['example']['blocked_sources'] == [2]),
        ('v0', 'Independent v0 destination: auxiliary v0 false dependency',
         lambda r: r['vd'] == 0 and r['vd'] not in (r['vs1'], r['vs2'])
         and r['example'] is not None and r['example']['blocked_sources'] == [3]),
        ('true', 'Safety control: real vs1 dependency remains',
         lambda r: r['vd'] == r['vs1'] == 10 and r['wait_phases']
         and r.get('source_observation', {}).get('states', [1])[0] == 0),
    ]
    result = []
    for name, title, predicate in cases:
        # Deterministic first qualifying completed record, not shortest/fastest.
        b = next(r for r in before['records'] if 'output_time' in r and predicate(r))
        a = next(r for r in after['records'] if r['index'] == b['index'])
        assert 'output_time' in a
        assert all(a[k] == b[k] for k in ('pc', 'call', 'vd', 'vs1', 'vs2'))
        result.append({'name': name, 'title': title, 'before': b, 'after': a})
    return result


def extract(path, cases, role):
    """Stream the VCD; keep only falling-edge snapshots in three small windows."""
    scopes, names, declarations, values = [], {}, {}, {}
    entries, selected = [], set()
    current_time, old_clock = 0, None
    records = {c['name']: c[role] for c in cases}
    windows = {k: (r['dispatch_time'] - 2, r['output_time'] + 4) for k, r in records.items()}
    end_time = max(end for _, end in windows.values())
    rows = {k: [] for k in records}

    def get(name):
        value = values.get(names[name])
        if value is None:
            raise ValueError(f'unknown required signal {name} at {current_time}')
        return value

    def sample():
        nonlocal old_clock
        clock = get('TOP.clock')
        falling = old_clock == 1 and clock == 0
        old_clock = clock
        if not falling:
            return
        for key, (start, end) in windows.items():
            if not start <= current_time <= end:
                continue
            rec = records[key]
            target = tuple(rec['tag'])
            row = {'time': current_time, 'cycle': (current_time - rec['dispatch_time']) / 2,
                   'iq_present': 0, 'target_out': 0, 'false_wait': 0, 'real_wait': 0,
                   'entry': None, 'result': None}
            if current_time == rec['dispatch_time']:
                matches = []
                if get(audit.DISPATCH + 'io_enqRob_canAccept'):
                    for i in range(6):
                        p = audit.DISPATCH + f'io_enqRob_req_{i}_bits_'
                        if get(audit.DISPATCH + f'io_enqRob_req_{i}_valid'):
                            tag = (get(p + 'robIdx_flag'), get(p + 'robIdx_value'))
                            if tag == target:
                                matches.append((get(p + 'pc'), get(p + 'instr')))
                assert len(matches) == 1 and matches[0][0] == int(rec['pc'], 16)
                assert matches[0][1] & 0xfc00707f == 0x0000200b
            for entry in entries:
                if not get(entry + 'io_commonOut_valid'):
                    continue
                p = entry + 'entryReg_status_'
                tag = (get(p + 'robIdx_flag'), get(p + 'robIdx_value'))
                if tag != target or get(entry + 'entryReg_payload_fuOpType') != 0x160:
                    continue
                assert not row['iq_present'], 'duplicate target allocation in IQ'
                row.update(iq_present=1, entry=entry,
                    states=[get(p + f'srcStatus_{j}_srcState') for j in range(5)],
                    types=[get(p + f'srcStatus_{j}_srcType') for j in range(5)],
                    psrc=[get(p + f'srcStatus_{j}_psrc') for j in range(5)],
                    issued=get(p + 'issued'), blocked=get(p + 'blocked'),
                    can_issue=get(entry + 'io_commonOut_canIssue'))
                busy = [j for j, value in enumerate(row['states']) if value == 0]
                waiting = bool(busy and not row['issued'] and not row['blocked'])
                if waiting:
                    assert row['can_issue'] == 0
                independent = rec['vd'] not in (rec['vs1'], rec['vs2'])
                old_only = set(busy) <= ({2, 3} if rec['vd'] == 0 else {2})
                row['false_wait'] = int(waiting and independent and old_only)
                row['real_wait'] = int(waiting and not independent)
                if row['false_wait']:
                    assert rec['producer']['pdest'] in [row['psrc'][j] for j in busy]
            if get(audit.FU + 'io_out_valid') and get(audit.FU + 'io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_fuOpType') == 0x160:
                tag = (get(audit.FU + 'io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_flag'), get(audit.FU + 'io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_value'))
                if tag == target:
                    row.update(target_out=1, result=get(audit.FU + 'io_out_bits_res_data'))
            rows[key].append(row)

    with Path(path).open(encoding='ascii') as stream:
        for raw in stream:
            line = raw.strip()
            if line.startswith('$scope'):
                scopes.append(line.split()[2])
            elif line.startswith('$upscope'):
                scopes.pop()
            elif line.startswith('$var'):
                fields = line.split()
                name = '.'.join(scopes + [fields[4]])
                if name == 'TOP.clock' or name.startswith((audit.IQ, audit.DISPATCH, audit.FU)):
                    names[name] = fields[3]
                    declarations[name] = {'code': fields[3], 'width': int(fields[2])}
            elif line.startswith('$enddefinitions'):
                entries = sorted(n.removesuffix('io_commonOut_valid') for n in names
                    if n.startswith(audit.IQ) and '.othersEntries' in n and n.endswith('.io_commonOut_valid'))
                required = ['TOP.clock', audit.DISPATCH + 'io_enqRob_canAccept']
                for i in range(6):
                    required += [audit.DISPATCH + f'io_enqRob_req_{i}_valid']
                    required += [audit.DISPATCH + f'io_enqRob_req_{i}_bits_' + field
                                 for field in ('pc', 'instr', 'robIdx_flag', 'robIdx_value')]
                for entry in entries:
                    required += [entry + n for n in ('io_commonOut_valid', 'io_commonOut_canIssue', 'entryReg_payload_fuOpType')]
                    required += [entry + 'entryReg_status_' + n for n in ('robIdx_flag', 'robIdx_value', 'issued', 'blocked')]
                    required += [entry + f'entryReg_status_srcStatus_{j}_' + n
                                 for j in range(5) for n in ('srcState', 'srcType', 'psrc')]
                required += [audit.FU + n for n in ('io_out_valid', 'io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_fuOpType',
                    'io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_flag', 'io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_value', 'io_out_bits_res_data')]
                assert entries and all(n in names for n in required), 'missing VCD signals'
                selected = {names[n] for n in required}
                declarations = {n: declarations[n] for n in required}
            elif line.startswith('#'):
                if values:
                    sample()
                current_time = int(line[1:])
                if current_time > end_time + 2:
                    break
            elif line.startswith('b'):
                bits, code = line[1:].split()
                if code in selected:
                    values[code] = None if any(c in bits.lower() for c in 'xz') else int(bits, 2)
            elif line and line[0] in '01xz' and line[1:] in selected:
                values[line[1:]] = int(line[0]) if line[0] in '01' else None

    for name, snapshots in rows.items():
        rec = records[name]
        assert all(b['time'] - a['time'] == 2 for a, b in zip(snapshots, snapshots[1:]))
        obs = next(r for r in snapshots if r['time'] == rec['source_observation']['time'])
        assert all(obs[k] == rec['source_observation'][k] for k in ('entry', 'states', 'types', 'psrc'))
        assert [r['time'] for r in snapshots if r['false_wait']] == rec['false_wait_phases']
        if rec['vd'] in (rec['vs1'], rec['vs2']):
            assert [r['time'] for r in snapshots if r['real_wait']] == rec['wait_phases']
        outputs = [(r['time'], r['result']) for r in snapshots if r['target_out']]
        assert outputs == [(rec['output_time'], rec['result'])]
    return {'declarations': declarations, 'windows': rows}


TRACKS = [
    ('IQ target present *', 'bool', lambda s: s['iq_present']),
    ('src0 ready (real vs1)', 'bool', lambda s: s.get('states', [None] * 5)[0]),
    ('src1 ready (real vs2)', 'bool', lambda s: s.get('states', [None] * 5)[1]),
    ('src2 type (oldVd)', 'bus', lambda s: s.get('types', [None] * 5)[2]),
    ('src2 ready', 'bool', lambda s: s.get('states', [None] * 5)[2]),
    ('src3 type (aux v0)', 'bus', lambda s: s.get('types', [None] * 5)[3]),
    ('src3 ready', 'bool', lambda s: s.get('states', [None] * 5)[3]),
    ('canIssue (eligibility)', 'bool', lambda s: s.get('can_issue')),
    ('issued / blocked', 'bus', lambda s: None if not s['iq_present'] else f'{s["issued"]}/{s["blocked"]}'),
    ('false readiness wait *', 'bool', lambda s: s['false_wait']),
    ('real readiness wait *', 'bool', lambda s: s['real_wait']),
    ('Vimac target out *', 'bool', lambda s: s['target_out']),
    ('result [127:0]', 'bus', lambda s: s['result']),
]


def svg_figure(case, extracts):
    width, height = 1560, 1110
    parts = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">',
        '<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#f4f7fb"/>',
        '<style>text{font-family:DejaVu Sans,sans-serif;fill:#172b4d}.mono{font-family:DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace}</style>']
    def text(x, y, value, size=17, color='#172b4d', weight='normal'):
        parts.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" font-size="{size}" font-weight="{weight}" style="fill:{color}">{html.escape(str(value))}</text>')
    def line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, stroke=1):
        parts.append(f'<path d="M{x1},{y1} L{x2},{y2}" fill="none" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{stroke}"/>')
    text(35, 39, case['title'], 25, weight='bold')
    rec = case['before']
    text(35, 68, f'Same probe: record {rec["index"]}, call {rec["call"]}, PC {rec["pc"]}, vd=v{rec["vd"]}, vs1=v{rec["vs1"]}, vs2=v{rec["vs2"]}', 17)
    text(35, 94, 'Measured falling-edge samples; ROB-qualified IQ/FU tracks. Gray = target absent (not logic zero).', 16)
    max_cycle = max((case[r]['output_time'] - case[r]['dispatch_time']) / 2 + 3 for r in ('before', 'after'))
    x0, plot_width = 355, 1150
    def x(cycle):
        return x0 + (cycle + 1) * plot_width / (max_cycle + 1)
    for pane, role in enumerate(('before', 'after')):
        top = 114 + pane * 454
        samples = extracts[role]['windows'][case['name']]
        rec = case[role]
        parts.append(f'<rect x="24" y="{top}" width="1512" height="442" rx="12" fill="white" stroke="#d5dfeb"/>')
        label = 'v0.1 BEFORE' if role == 'before' else 'P1 AFTER'
        color = '#b54708' if role == 'before' else '#087f5b'
        delay = (rec['output_time'] - rec['dispatch_time']) // 2
        text(40, top + 29, f'{label}   ROB({rec["tag"][0]},{rec["tag"][1]})   dispatch {rec["dispatch_time"]} -> output {rec["output_time"]}   interval {delay} DUT cycles', 19, color, 'bold')
        producer = rec['producer']
        obs = rec['source_observation']
        text(40, top + 52, f'Previous writer ROB{tuple(producer["tag"])} -> P{producer["pdest"]}; first IQ psrc={obs["psrc"]}; types={obs["types"]}', 15)
        y0, row_height = top + 82, 25
        for c in range(-1, int(max_cycle) + 1):
            line(x(c), y0 - 12, x(c), y0 + len(TRACKS) * row_height - 3, '#e7edf4')
            text(x(c) - 5, top + 433, c, 13)
        for ri, (label, kind, getter) in enumerate(TRACKS):
            yc = y0 + ri * row_height
            text(40, yc + 5, label, 15)
            for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
                left = x(sample['cycle'])
                right = x(sample['cycle'] + 1)
                value = getter(sample)
                if value is None:
                    parts.append(f'<rect x="{left:.2f}" y="{yc - 9}" width="{right - left:.2f}" height="18" fill="#edf1f5"/>')
                    continue
                if kind == 'bool':
                    yy = yc - 7 if value else yc + 7
                    line(left, yy, right, yy, color, 2)
                    if i and getter(samples[i - 1]) is not None and getter(samples[i - 1]) != value:
                        prev = yc - 7 if getter(samples[i - 1]) else yc + 7
                        line(left, prev, left, yy, color, 2)
                    # Dots distinguish observed samples from sample-hold display.
                    parts.append(f'<circle cx="{left:.2f}" cy="{yy}" r="2" fill="{color}"/>')
                else:
                    line(left, yc - 9, right, yc - 9, color)
                    line(left, yc + 9, right, yc + 9, color)
                    if not i or getter(samples[i - 1]) != value:
                        line(left, yc - 9, left, yc + 9, color)
                        rendered = {0: 'no', 4: 'vp', 8: 'v0'}.get(value, str(value)) if 'type' in label else str(value)
                        text(left + 3, yc + 5, rendered, 13, color)
        line(x(0), y0 - 12, x(0), y0 + len(TRACKS) * row_height - 3, '#2c6ecb', 2)
        out_cycle = (rec['output_time'] - rec['dispatch_time']) / 2
        line(x(out_cycle), y0 - 12, x(out_cycle), y0 + len(TRACKS) * row_height - 3, '#805ad5', 2)
    text(35, 1049, 'Horizontal axis: DUT cycles relative to this target dispatch. 2 VCD ticks/cycle; dump times are NOT physical chip timing.', 15)
    text(35, 1073, '* Derived tag-qualified indicator, not an RTL port. canIssue is eligibility, NOT an actual issue grant or commit.', 15)
    text(35, 1097, 'Sources: original before/after VCD + PASS audits. Exact names, sampled values and hashes are in p1-wave-excerpts.json.', 15)
    parts.append('</svg>')
    return '\n'.join(parts)


def png_from_svg(svg_path, png_path):
    """Rasterize the data-generated SVG using existing system libraries."""
    rsvg = ctypes.CDLL('librsvg-2.so.2')
    cairo = ctypes.CDLL('libcairo.so.2')
    obj = ctypes.CDLL('libgobject-2.0.so.0')
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_new_from_data.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_new_from_data.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_render_cairo.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_render_cairo.restype = ctypes.c_int
    cairo.cairo_image_surface_create.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
    cairo.cairo_image_surface_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    cairo.cairo_create.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    cairo.cairo_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
    cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png.restype = ctypes.c_int
    cairo.cairo_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    cairo.cairo_surface_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    obj.g_object_unref.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    data = svg_path.read_bytes()
    error = ctypes.c_void_p()
    handle = rsvg.rsvg_handle_new_from_data(data, len(data), ctypes.byref(error))
    assert handle and not error.value, 'SVG parser failed'
    surface = cairo.cairo_image_surface_create(0, 1560, 1110)
    context = cairo.cairo_create(surface)
    try:
        assert rsvg.rsvg_handle_render_cairo(handle, context), 'SVG rendering failed'
        assert cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png(surface, str(png_path).encode()) == 0
    finally:
        cairo.cairo_destroy(context)
        cairo.cairo_surface_destroy(surface)
        obj.g_object_unref(handle)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = args.out.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    outputs = ['p1-wave-excerpts.json', 'p1-wave-figure-manifest.json']
    outputs += [f'p1-{name}.{ext}' for name in ('oldvd', 'v0', 'true') for ext in ('svg', 'png')]
    assert not any((out / name).exists() for name in outputs), 'refusing to overwrite existing figures'
    audits, sources = {}, {}
    for role, (wave_name, audit_name) in SOURCES.items():
        a = json.loads((ROOT / audit_name).read_text())
        assert a['status'] == 'PASS'
        assert sha(ROOT / wave_name) == a['wave_sha256'], 'original wave identity changed'
        audits[role] = a
        sources[role] = {'wave': wave_name, 'wave_sha256': a['wave_sha256'],
            'audit': audit_name, 'audit_sha256': sha(ROOT / audit_name)}
        print('[source hash PASS]', role, flush=True)
    cases = choose(audits['before'], audits['after'])
    extracts = {}
    for role, (wave_name, _) in SOURCES.items():
        print('[extract start]', role, flush=True)
        extracts[role] = extract(ROOT / wave_name, cases, role)
        print('[snapshot cross-check PASS]', role, flush=True)
    contract = {'method': 'Real VCD falling-edge samples, target ROB allocation qualification; gray means absent',
        'selection': 'first qualifying completed record per category, paired by record index and probe identity',
        'source_hashes_checked': True, 'cycles_per_vcd_tick': 0.5,
        'sources': sources, 'cases': cases, 'extracts': extracts,
        'limitations': 'Not full-transition GUI screenshots, actual issue grant/commit proof, isolated FU latency or PPA.'}
    (out / 'p1-wave-excerpts.json').write_text(json.dumps(contract, indent=2) + '\n')
    for case in cases:
        svg_path = out / ('p1-' + case['name'] + '.svg')
        png_path = svg_path.with_suffix('.png')
        svg_path.write_text(svg_figure(case, extracts))
        png_from_svg(svg_path, png_path)
        print('[figure PASS]', png_path, flush=True)
    manifest = {'status': 'PASS', 'generator': str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)),
        'generator_sha256': sha(__file__), 'sources': sources,
        'files': {p.name: sha(p) for p in sorted(out.iterdir()) if p.is_file()},
        'cross_checks': 'dispatch opcode/PC/ROB, first IQ observation, all wait phases, FU output time/full128 result'}
    (out / 'p1-wave-figure-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('[all figures PASS]', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

                required = ['TOP.clock', audit.DISPATCH + 'io_enqRob_canAccept']

def svg_figure(case, extracts):
    width, height = 1560, 1110
    parts = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">',
        '<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#f4f7fb"/>',
        '<style>text{font-family:DejaVu Sans,sans-serif;fill:#172b4d}.mono{font-family:DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace}</style>']
    def text(x, y, value, size=17, color='#172b4d', weight='normal'):
        parts.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" font-size="{size}" font-weight="{weight}" style="fill:{color}">{html.escape(str(value))}</text>')
    def line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, stroke=1):
        parts.append(f'<path d="M{x1},{y1} L{x2},{y2}" fill="none" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{stroke}"/>')
    text(35, 39, case['title'], 25, weight='bold')
    rec = case['before']
    text(35, 68, f'Same probe: record {rec["index"]}, call {rec["call"]}, PC {rec["pc"]}, vd=v{rec["vd"]}, vs1=v{rec["vs1"]}, vs2=v{rec["vs2"]}', 17)
    text(35, 94, 'Measured falling-edge samples; ROB-qualified IQ/FU tracks. Gray = target absent (not logic zero).', 16)
    max_cycle = max((case[r]['output_time'] - case[r]['dispatch_time']) / 2 + 3 for r in ('before', 'after'))
    x0, plot_width = 355, 1150
    def x(cycle):
        return x0 + (cycle + 1) * plot_width / (max_cycle + 1)
    for pane, role in enumerate(('before', 'after')):
        top = 114 + pane * 454
        samples = extracts[role]['windows'][case['name']]
        rec = case[role]
        parts.append(f'<rect x="24" y="{top}" width="1512" height="442" rx="12" fill="white" stroke="#d5dfeb"/>')
        label = 'v0.1 BEFORE' if role == 'before' else 'P1 AFTER'
        color = '#b54708' if role == 'before' else '#087f5b'
        delay = (rec['output_time'] - rec['dispatch_time']) // 2
        text(40, top + 29, f'{label}   ROB({rec["tag"][0]},{rec["tag"][1]})   dispatch {rec["dispatch_time"]} -> output {rec["output_time"]}   interval {delay} DUT cycles', 19, color, 'bold')
        producer = rec['producer']
        obs = rec['source_observation']
        text(40, top + 52, f'Previous writer ROB{tuple(producer["tag"])} -> P{producer["pdest"]}; first IQ psrc={obs["psrc"]}; types={obs["types"]}', 15)
        y0, row_height = top + 82, 25
        for c in range(-1, int(max_cycle) + 1):
            line(x(c), y0 - 12, x(c), y0 + len(TRACKS) * row_height - 3, '#e7edf4')
            text(x(c) - 5, top + 433, c, 13)
        for ri, (label, kind, getter) in enumerate(TRACKS):
            yc = y0 + ri * row_height
            text(40, yc + 5, label, 15)
            for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
                left = x(sample['cycle'])
                right = x(sample['cycle'] + 1)
                value = getter(sample)
                if value is None:
                    parts.append(f'<rect x="{left:.2f}" y="{yc - 9}" width="{right - left:.2f}" height="18" fill="#edf1f5"/>')
                    continue
                if kind == 'bool':
                    yy = yc - 7 if value else yc + 7
                    line(left, yy, right, yy, color, 2)
                    if i and getter(samples[i - 1]) is not None and getter(samples[i - 1]) != value:
                        prev = yc - 7 if getter(samples[i - 1]) else yc + 7
                        line(left, prev, left, yy, color, 2)
                    # 用圆点区分真实采样点与保持显示的区段。
                    parts.append(f'<circle cx="{left:.2f}" cy="{yy}" r="2" fill="{color}"/>')
                else:
                    line(left, yc - 9, right, yc - 9, color)
                    line(left, yc + 9, right, yc + 9, color)
                    if not i or getter(samples[i - 1]) != value:
                        line(left, yc - 9, left, yc + 9, color)
                        rendered = {0: 'no', 4: 'vp', 8: 'v0'}.get(value, str(value)) if 'type' in label else str(value)
                        text(left + 3, yc + 5, rendered, 13, color)
        line(x(0), y0 - 12, x(0), y0 + len(TRACKS) * row_height - 3, '#2c6ecb', 2)
        out_cycle = (rec['output_time'] - rec['dispatch_time']) / 2
        line(x(out_cycle), y0 - 12, x(out_cycle), y0 + len(TRACKS) * row_height - 3, '#805ad5', 2)
    text(35, 1049, 'Horizontal axis: DUT cycles relative to this target dispatch. 2 VCD ticks/cycle; dump times are NOT physical chip timing.', 15)
    text(35, 1073, '* Derived tag-qualified indicator, not an RTL port. canIssue is eligibility, NOT an actual issue grant or commit.', 15)
    text(35, 1097, 'Sources: original before/after VCD + PASS audits. Exact names, sampled values and hashes are in p1-wave-excerpts.json.', 15)
    parts.append('</svg>')
    return '\n'.join(parts)


def png_from_svg(svg_path, png_path):
    """使用已有系统图形库将数据生成的 SVG 转为 PNG。"""
    rsvg = ctypes.CDLL('librsvg-2.so.2')
    cairo = ctypes.CDLL('libcairo.so.2')
    obj = ctypes.CDLL('libgobject-2.0.so.0')
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_new_from_data.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_new_from_data.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_render_cairo.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
    rsvg.rsvg_handle_render_cairo.restype = ctypes.c_int
    cairo.cairo_image_surface_create.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
    cairo.cairo_image_surface_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    cairo.cairo_create.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    cairo.cairo_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
    cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png.restype = ctypes.c_int
    cairo.cairo_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    cairo.cairo_surface_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    obj.g_object_unref.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    data = svg_path.read_bytes()
    error = ctypes.c_void_p()
    handle = rsvg.rsvg_handle_new_from_data(data, len(data), ctypes.byref(error))
    assert handle and not error.value, 'SVG parser failed'
    surface = cairo.cairo_image_surface_create(0, 1560, 1110)
    context = cairo.cairo_create(surface)
    try:
        assert rsvg.rsvg_handle_render_cairo(handle, context), 'SVG rendering failed'
        assert cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png(surface, str(png_path).encode()) == 0
    finally:
        cairo.cairo_destroy(context)
        cairo.cairo_surface_destroy(surface)
        obj.g_object_unref(handle)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT)
    args = parser.parse_args()

        'cross_checks': 'dispatch opcode/PC/ROB, first IQ observation, all wait phases, FU output time/full128 result'}
    (out / 'p1-wave-figure-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract actual signal transitions from the EXISTING CPU VCD, without simulation."""
import argparse

BASE = 'TOP.SimTop.l_soc.core_with_l2.core.backend.inner_vfExuBlock.exus.Vimac'
FIELDS = {'top_clock':'TOP.clock', 'clock':BASE+'.vdot.clock', 'reset':BASE+'.reset',
          'enable0':BASE+'.vdot.io_enable_0', 'enable1':BASE+'.vdot.io_enable_1',

          'vl':BASE+'.io_in_bits_dataPipe_2_src_4', 'vm':BASE+'.io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_vpu_vm',
          'vstart':BASE+'.io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_vpu_vstart',
          'illegal':BASE+'.io_out_bits_ctrl_exceptionVec_2', 'vxsat':BASE+'.io_out_bits_res_vxsat'}
FIELDS.update({f'p{i}':BASE+f'.vdot.products_{i}' for i in range(8)})
CASES = [('positive36',36),('positive120',120),('negative',-36),('maximum',131072),
         ('minimum',-130048),('positive-endpoint',129032),('zero',0)]


def need(value,message):
    if not value:raise ValueError(message)


def signed(value,bits):
    return value-(1<<bits) if value & (1<<(bits-1)) else value


def operands(value):
    return [signed((value>>(8*i))&255,8) for i in range(8)]


def reference(left,right,time):
    a,b=operands(left),operands(right)
    products=[x*y for x,y in zip(a,b)]
    return dict(input_time=time,a=a,b=b,products=products,expected=sum(products))


def audit_output(snapshot,reference_value):
    expected=reference_value['expected']&0xffffffff
    need(snapshot['result']==snapshot['dot_result']==expected,'full128 result mismatch')
    need(signed(snapshot['sum'],19)==reference_value['expected'],'registered sum mismatch')
    need((snapshot['vl'],snapshot['vm'],snapshot['vstart'])==(8,1,0),'illegal selected configuration')
    need(snapshot['illegal']==snapshot['vxsat']==0,'exception/saturation on legal dot')


def extract(path,observed):
    """Carry exact VCD values through each timestamp; audit low phases independently."""
    targets={}
    for name,value in CASES:
        row=next(r for r in observed if r['signed']==value)
        targets[row['time']]=dict(name=name,expected=value,row=row,samples=[])
    stop=max(r['time'] for r in observed)+10
    scope=[];codes={};values={};selected=set();time=0;previous_clock=None
    products_ref=sum_ref=None;checked=[]

    def snapshot():
        nonlocal previous_clock,products_ref,sum_ref
        if not codes:return
        sample={key:values.get(code) for key,code in codes.items()}
        sample['time']=time
        for target in targets.values():
            if target['row']['time']-12<=time<=target['row']['time']+8:
                target['samples'].append(sample.copy())
        clock=sample['top_clock'];low=previous_clock==1 and clock==0;previous_clock=clock
        if not low or sample['reset']:return
        for key in ('enable0','enable1','valid','op'):
            need(sample[key] is not None,'unknown control at low phase')
        if products_ref is not None:
            need([signed(sample[f'p{i}'],16) for i in range(8)]==products_ref['products'],
                 'product register mismatch')
            products_ref.setdefault('products_time',time)
        if sum_ref is not None:
            need(signed(sample['sum'],19)==sum_ref['expected'],'sum pipeline mismatch')
            sum_ref.setdefault('sum_time',time)
        if sample['valid'] and sample['op']==0x160 and sum_ref is not None:
            audit_output(sample,sum_ref)
            row=next((r for r in observed if r['time']==time),None)
            need(row is not None and row['value']==sample['result']
                 and row['tag']==f"{sample['rob_flag']}:{sample['rob_index']}",
                 'original CPU audit identity differs')
            checked.append(time)
            if time in targets:
                target=targets[time];target['input']=sum_ref.copy();target['output']=sample.copy()
        if sample['enable1']:sum_ref=None if products_ref is None else products_ref.copy()
        if sample['enable0']:
            products_ref=reference(sample['vs1'],sample['vs2'],time)

    before=path.stat()
    with path.open(encoding='ascii') as stream:
        for raw in stream:
            fields=raw.split()
            if not fields:continue
            if fields[0]=='$scope':scope.append(fields[2])
            elif fields[0]=='$upscope':scope.pop()
            elif fields[0]=='$var':
                name='.'.join(scope+[fields[4]])
                for key,wanted in FIELDS.items():
                    if name==wanted:codes[key]=fields[3]
            elif fields[0]=='$enddefinitions':break
        need(set(codes)==set(FIELDS),'missing actual CPU signal hierarchy')
        selected=set(codes.values())
        for raw in stream:
            line=raw.strip()
            if line.startswith('#'):
                snapshot();time=int(line[1:])
                if time>stop:break
            elif line.startswith('b'):
                bits,code=line[1:].split()
                if code in selected:values[code]=None if any(c in bits.lower() for c in 'xz') else int(bits,2)
            elif line and line[0] in '01xz':
                code=line[1:]
                if code in selected:values[code]=int(line[0]) if line[0] in '01' else None
    need(checked==[r['time'] for r in observed],'incomplete original 29-output recheck')
    after=path.stat()
    need((before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==(after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns),'source waveform changed')
    result=[]
    for name,value in CASES:
        target=next(v for v in targets.values() if v['name']==name)
        need('input' in target and 'output' in target and target['input']['expected']==value,'missing case')
        need(target['samples'][0]['time']<=target['input']['input_time'],'input outside selected window')
        result.append(target)
    return dict(status='PASS',source=str(path),hierarchy=BASE,fields=FIELDS,checked_outputs=len(checked),cases=result,
                interpretation='Exact timestamp-stable VCD values. Low-phase checks independently reconstruct products and sum. FU result is not retirement.')

"""Synthetic checkpoint tests, not CPU performance or RTL evidence."""
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value


queue = load('isolation_queue', ROOT / 'scripts/complete-vdot-isolation-performance.py')
fixtures = load('isolation_fixtures', Path(__file__).with_name('test-analyze-bench.py'))


class QueueTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        (self.root / 'stage3/logs').mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.root / 'stage3/reports').mkdir()
        self.checkpoint = self.root / 'checkpoint.json'

    def slot(self, profile='smoke', index=0, emu=None, suffix=''):
        first = index % 2
        image = queue.EXPECTED[profile]
        text = fixtures.fixture(first, index, profile).replace('schema=2', 'schema=3')
        text = text.replace('a'*64, emu or queue.EXPECTED['emu'])
        text = text.replace('b'*64, queue.EXPECTED['ref'])
        text = text.replace(('c' if first == 0 else 'd')*64, image)
        record = dict(first=first, image_sha256=image, offset=16, overwrite_nbytes=17,
                      changed_offsets=[16] if first else [], parameter_address='0x80000010',
                      overlay_sha256=('e' if first else 'f')*64)
        text += '[runtime parameter] ' + json.dumps(record) + '\n'
        summary = self.root / 'stage3/logs' / f'synthetic-{profile}-{index}{suffix}-bench.log'
        log = summary.with_name(summary.name.replace('.log', '.full.log'))
        log.write_text(text)
        summary.write_text('synthetic summary only\n')
        return dict(profile=profile, index=index, summary=str(summary), log=str(log))

    def test_interrupted_attempt_preserved_and_not_marked_completed(self):
        slot = self.slot()
        log = Path(slot['log'])
        log.write_text('Difftest enabled\npartial UART\n')
        original = log.read_bytes()
        state = dict(slots=[], pending=slot)
        queue.recover_pending(state, self.checkpoint)
        self.assertEqual(state['slots'], [])
        self.assertEqual(state['interrupted'], [slot])
        self.assertNotIn('pending', state)
        self.assertEqual(log.read_bytes(), original)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.checkpoint.read_text()), state)

    def test_completed_pending_accepted_exactly_once(self):
        slot = self.slot()
        state = dict(slots=[], pending=slot)
        queue.recover_pending(state, self.checkpoint)
        queue.recover_pending(state, self.checkpoint)
        self.assertEqual(len(state['slots']), 1)
        self.assertIn('log_sha256', state['slots'][0])
        self.assertNotIn('pending', state)

    def test_recorded_failure_and_explicit_failure_are_not_retried(self):
        for text in ('[process exit] 17\n', 'benchmark FAIL\n', 'HIT BAD TRAP\n'):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                slot = self.slot()
                Path(slot['log']).write_text(text)
                state = dict(slots=[], pending=slot)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    queue.recover_pending(state, self.checkpoint)
                self.assertIn('pending', state)
                self.assertEqual(state['slots'], [])

    def test_wrong_identity_order_and_schema_rejected(self):
        slot = self.slot(emu='9'*64)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            queue.validate_slot(slot)
        slot = self.slot()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            queue.validate_slot(dict(slot, index=1))
        Path(slot['log']).write_text(Path(slot['log']).read_text().replace('schema=3', 'schema=2'))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            queue.validate_slot(slot)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            queue.recover_pending(dict(slots=[], pending=dict(slot, index=1)), self.checkpoint)

    def test_frozen_change_and_evidence_overwrite_rejected(self):
        path = self.root / 'frozen'
        path.write_text('original')
        state = dict(frozen={str(path): queue.digest(path)})
        queue.check_frozen(state)
        path.write_text('changed')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            queue.check_frozen(state)
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            queue.exclusive(path, 'overwrite')
        self.assertEqual(path.read_text(), 'changed')

    def test_reports_keep_all_samples_and_are_idempotent(self):
        slots = [self.slot('smoke', i) for i in range(2)] + [self.slot('full', i) for i in range(4)]
        before = [self.slot('full', i, emu='9'*64, suffix='-before') for i in range(4)]
        baseline = self.root / 'stage3/logs/baseline.paths'
        baseline.write_text(''.join(s['summary']+'\n' for s in before))
        prefix = self.root / 'stage3/logs/synthetic-isolation'
        with patch.object(queue, 'ROOT', self.root), patch.object(queue, 'BASELINE', baseline):
            strict, report = queue.write_reports(dict(slots=slots), prefix)
            text = report.read_text()
            self.assertIn('合成测试报告（不是硬件实测）', text)
            self.assertIn('P1 → 隔离核同协议对比', text)
            self.assertEqual(text.count('100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100'), 12)
            self.assertEqual(strict, 0)
            self.assertEqual(queue.write_reports(dict(slots=slots), prefix)[0], strict)
            self.assertEqual(report.read_text(), text)
            report.write_text('changed evidence')
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                queue.write_reports(dict(slots=slots), prefix)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import hashlib

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
LEDGER=ROOT/'manifest/document-review-edition-20261101.json'


def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:return hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()


class ReviewerDocumentTests(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_all_reviewer_markdown_is_clean(self):
        forbidden=re.compile(r'哈希|指纹|冻结|\bsha(?:[-_ ]?(?:1|256|512))?\b|\bhash(?:es)?\b|\b[0-9a-f]{40,64}\b',re.I)

            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(entry['original_content'].encode()).hexdigest(),entry['original_sha256'],name)
            self.assertEqual((ROOT/name).read_text(),entry['review_content'],name)

            self.assertNotRegex(review.read_text(),r'(?i)\bhash(?:es)?\b|\bsha(?:256)?\b')

"""Artificial VCD fixture validates the checker, NOT CPU evidence."""
import importlib.util
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("timer",Path(__file__).with_name("check-timer-wave.py"))
timer=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(timer)


def fixture(directory, bad=None):
    d="TOP.SimTop.l_soc.core_with_l2.core.backend.inner_ctrlBlock.dispatch."
    r="TOP.SimTop.l_soc.core_with_l2.core.backend.inner_ctrlBlock.rob."
    c="TOP.SimTop.l_soc.core_with_l2.core.backend.inner_intExuBlock.exus_7.csr."
    names=["TOP.clock",d+"io_enqRob_canAccept",d+"io_enqRob_isEmpty",r+"hasBlockBackward",c+"io_out_valid",
           c+"io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_flag",c+"io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_value",c+"io_out_bits_res_data"]
    for i in range(6):
        names += [d+f"io_enqRob_req_{i}_valid"]
        names += [d+f"io_enqRob_req_{i}_bits_"+n for n in ("instr","pc","robIdx_flag","robIdx_value","waitForward","blockBackward")]
    codes={n:f"s{i}" for i,n in enumerate(names)}
    # Full dotted names work as references without nested scopes.
    lines=["$timescale 1ns $end"]+[f"$var wire 64 {codes[n]} {n} $end" for n in names]+["$enddefinitions $end"]
    clock=0
    def emit(changes):
        nonlocal clock
        base={n:0 for n in names}; base[d+"io_enqRob_canAccept"]=1; base[d+"io_enqRob_isEmpty"]=1
        base.update(changes)
        for level in (1,0):
            clock+=1; lines.append(f"#{clock}"); base["TOP.clock"]=level
            lines.extend(f"b{v:b} {codes[n]}" for n,v in base.items())
    tag=0
    def op(inst, data):
        nonlocal tag
        tag+=1; p=d+"io_enqRob_req_0_bits_"
        marker=inst==0x00805073
        emit({d+"io_enqRob_req_0_valid":1,p+"instr":inst,p+"pc":0x80000100+tag*4,p+"robIdx_value":tag,
              p+"waitForward":int(marker and bad!="flag"),p+"blockBackward":int(marker)})
        emit({r+"hasBlockBackward":int(marker),d+"io_enqRob_canAccept":int(not marker or bad=="block"),
              c+"io_out_valid":1,c+"io_out_bits_ctrl_robIdx_value":tag,c+"io_out_bits_res_data":data})
    for k in range(3):
        for impl in range(2):
            op(0x00805073,0); op(0xb0002373,1000); op(0x00805073,0)
            op(0x00805073,0); op(0xb0002e73,1100+(bad=="delta"))
    wave,log=Path(directory)/"synthetic.vcd",Path(directory)/"synthetic.log"
    wave.write_text("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
    log.write_text("synthetic fixture, NOT hardware\nDifftest enabled\nHIT GOOD TRAP\ntimer probe PASS: synthetic\n"+
                   "\n".join(f"timer probe kind={k} impl={i} cycles=100" for k in range(3) for i in range(2))+"\n[exit] 0\n")
    return wave,log


class TimerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_complete_fixture(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            result=timer.check(*fixture(directory))
            self.assertEqual(len(result["checked_pairs"]),6)
            self.assertEqual(result["checked_markers"],18)
    def test_corruptions_rejected(self):
        for bad in ("flag","block","delta"):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad),tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory,self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                timer.check(*fixture(directory,bad))
    def test_interleaved_uart_commit_records(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            wave,log=fixture(directory)
            text=log.read_text().replace("timer probe kind=", "timer [00] commit pc 80000000 inst 13 wen 0 dst 0 data 0 idx 01\nprobe kind=")
            log.write_text(text)
            self.assertEqual(len(timer.check(wave,log)["checked_pairs"]),6)


if __name__=="__main__": unittest.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector
+
+import chisel3._
+import chisel3.util._
+
+/** Two explicitly enabled stages: full signed products, then exact reduction.
+  * The owner supplies stage enables from its control pipeline. Valid/flush and
+  * destination tags remain in the existing vector execution interface.
+  */
+class VDot8 extends Module {
+  val io = IO(new Bundle {
+    val vs1 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val vs2 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val sew16 = Input(Bool())
+    val enable = Input(Vec(2, Bool()))
+    val result = Output(UInt(128.W))
+  })
+
+  // Register enables alone do not isolate the combinational multipliers.
+  // Eight shared signed 16x16 multipliers. e8 selects/sign-extends the low
+  // eight bytes; e16 consumes all eight halfwords. Clamp BEFORE arithmetic.
+  val isolatedVs1 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs1, 0.U(128.W))
+  val isolatedVs2 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs2, 0.U(128.W))
+  val activeSew16 = io.enable(0) && io.sew16
+  val sew16S1 = RegEnable(io.sew16, io.enable(0))
+  val sew16S2 = RegEnable(sew16S1, io.enable(1))
+  def operand(src: UInt, i: Int): SInt = {
+    val byte = src(8 * i + 7, 8 * i)
+    Mux(activeSew16, src(16 * i + 15, 16 * i),
+      Cat(Fill(8, byte(7)), byte)).asSInt
+  }
+  val products = Reg(Vec(8, SInt(32.W)))
+  when(io.enable(0)) {
+    for (i <- 0 until 8) {
+      products(i) := operand(isolatedVs1, i) * operand(isolatedVs2, i)
+    }
+  }
+  val pairs = (0 until 4).map(i => products(2 * i) +& products(2 * i + 1))
+  val quads = (0 until 2).map(i => pairs(2 * i) +& pairs(2 * i + 1))
+  val sum = RegEnable(quads(0) +& quads(1), io.enable(1))
+  require(sum.getWidth == 35)
+  val sum32 = Wire(SInt(32.W))
+  sum32 := sum // e8 range fits exactly; e16 uses the separate 64-bit packing.
+  val sum64 = Wire(SInt(64.W))
+  sum64 := sum
+  io.result := Mux(sew16S2, Cat(0.U(64.W), sum64.asUInt),
+    Cat(0.U(96.W), sum32.asUInt))
+}

+/** Mirrors ExeUnit's fixed-time external control/data pipe with ready high. */
+class VDotIntegrationHarness(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSModule {
+  private val cfg = FuConfig.VimacCfg
+  val io = IO(new Bundle {
+    val valid = Input(Bool())
+    val cancel = Input(Bool())
+    val op = Input(UInt(9.W))
+    val tag = Input(UInt(6.W))
+    val vs1 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val vs2 = Input(UInt(128.W))

+    val vm = Input(Bool())
+    val vstart = Input(UInt(8.W))
+    val v0Dest = Input(Bool())
+    val outValid = Output(Bool())
+    val outTag = Output(UInt(8.W))
+    val result = Output(UInt(128.W))
+    val illegal = Output(Bool())
+    val saturated = Output(Bool())
+    val vecWen = Output(Bool())
+    val v0Wen = Output(Bool())
+  })
+  val fu = Module(new VIMacU(cfg))
+  val ctrl = WireInit(0.U.asTypeOf(new FuncUnitCtrlInput(cfg)))
+  ctrl.fuOpType := io.op
+  ctrl.robIdx.value := io.tag
+  ctrl.pdest := io.tag
+  ctrl.vecWen.get := !io.v0Dest
+  ctrl.v0Wen.get := io.v0Dest
+  ctrl.vpu.get.connectVType(io.config.vtype)
+  ctrl.vpu.get.vm := io.vm
+  ctrl.vpu.get.vstart := io.vstart
+  ctrl.vpu.get.lastUop := true.B
+  val data = WireInit(0.U.asTypeOf(new FuncUnitDataInput(cfg)))
+  data.src(0) := io.vs1
+  data.src(1) := io.vs2
+  data.src(2) := io.oldVd
+  data.src(cfg.maskSrcIdx) := io.mask
+  data.src(cfg.vconfigIdx) := io.config.vl
+  val ctrlPipe = ctrl +: Seq.fill(2)(Reg(chiselTypeOf(ctrl)))
+  val dataPipe = data +: Seq.fill(2)(Reg(chiselTypeOf(data)))
+  val validPipe = (io.valid && !io.cancel) +: Seq.fill(2)(RegInit(false.B))
+  for (i <- 1 to 2) {
+    ctrlPipe(i) := ctrlPipe(i - 1)
+    dataPipe(i) := dataPipe(i - 1)
+    validPipe(i) := validPipe(i - 1) && !io.cancel
+  }
+  fu.io.in.bits := 0.U.asTypeOf(fu.io.in.bits)
+  fu.io.in.valid := validPipe.head
+  fu.io.in.bits.ctrl := ctrl
+  fu.io.in.bits.data := data
+  for (i <- 0 to 2) {
+    fu.io.in.bits.ctrlPipe.get(i) := ctrlPipe(i)
+    fu.io.in.bits.dataPipe.get(i) := dataPipe(i)
+    fu.io.in.bits.validPipe.get(i) := validPipe(i)
+  }
+  fu.io.flush.valid := io.cancel
+  fu.io.flush.bits := 0.U.asTypeOf(fu.io.flush.bits)
+  fu.io.out.ready := true.B
+  fu.io.vxrm.foreach(_ := io.vxrm)
+  fu.io.frm.foreach(_ := 0.U)
+  io.outValid := fu.io.out.valid
+  io.outTag := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.pdest
+  io.result := fu.io.out.bits.res.data
+  io.illegal := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.exceptionVec.get(ExceptionNO.illegalInstr)
+  io.saturated := fu.io.out.bits.res.vxsat.get.asBool
+  io.vecWen := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.vecWen.get
+  io.v0Wen := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.v0Wen.get

+  it should "preserve randomized mixed traffic and ordinary mask tail multiply accumulate and saturation" in {

+      var random = new scala.util.Random(0x49534f4cL)

+      var pending = List.fill[Option[Expected]](2)(None)
+      var checked = 0
+      var issued = 0
+      var killed = 0
+
+      def signed(x: BigInt, width: Int): BigInt =
+        if (x.testBit(width - 1)) x - (BigInt(1) << width) else x

+      def tick(kind: String, sew: Int = 8, valid: Boolean = true, cancel: Boolean = false,

+        val width = sew
+        val count = 128 / width
+        val elemMask = (BigInt(1) << width) - 1
+        val a = if (forceSat) BigInt("80" * 16, 16) else BigInt(128, random)
+        val b = if (forceSat) a else BigInt(128, random)
+        val old = BigInt(128, random)
+        val mask = BigInt(128, random)
+        val vl = if (dot) 8 else if (forceSat) count else random.nextInt(count + 1)

new file mode 100644
index 000000000..5b1e8a25e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/main/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8.scala
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector
+
+import chisel3._
+import chisel3.util._
+
+/** 两级显式使能流水：第一级保存完整有符号乘积，第二级精确归约。
+  * 外层控制流水提供各级使能；有效、取消及目的标签沿用既有向量执行接口。
+  */
+class VDot8 extends Module {
+  val io = IO(new Bundle {
+    val vs1 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val vs2 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val sew16 = Input(Bool())
+    val enable = Input(Vec(2, Bool()))
+    val result = Output(UInt(128.W))
+  })
+
+  // 仅保持寄存器不能隔离组合乘法器，输入仍需在算术之前夹零。
+  // e8/e16 共用八个有符号 16×16 乘法器；e8 选择低八字节并符号扩展，
+  // e16 使用全部八个半字。操作数夹零必须放在算术逻辑之前。
+  val isolatedVs1 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs1, 0.U(128.W))
+  val isolatedVs2 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs2, 0.U(128.W))
+  val activeSew16 = io.enable(0) && io.sew16
+  val sew16S1 = RegEnable(io.sew16, io.enable(0))
+  val sew16S2 = RegEnable(sew16S1, io.enable(1))
+  def operand(src: UInt, i: Int): SInt = {
+    val byte = src(8 * i + 7, 8 * i)
+    Mux(activeSew16, src(16 * i + 15, 16 * i),
+      Cat(Fill(8, byte(7)), byte)).asSInt
+  }
+  val products = Reg(Vec(8, SInt(32.W)))
+  when(io.enable(0)) {
+    for (i <- 0 until 8) {
+      products(i) := operand(isolatedVs1, i) * operand(isolatedVs2, i)
+    }
+  }
+  val pairs = (0 until 4).map(i => products(2 * i) +& products(2 * i + 1))
+  val quads = (0 until 2).map(i => pairs(2 * i) +& pairs(2 * i + 1))
+  val sum = RegEnable(quads(0) +& quads(1), io.enable(1))
+  require(sum.getWidth == 35)
+  val sum32 = Wire(SInt(32.W))
+  sum32 := sum // e8 的精确结果可完整放入 32 位；e16 使用独立的 64 位打包路径。
+  val sum64 = Wire(SInt(64.W))
+  sum64 := sum
+  io.result := Mux(sew16S2, Cat(0.U(64.W), sum64.asUInt),
+    Cat(0.U(96.W), sum32.asUInt))
+}

+      def check(word: BigInt, vd: Int, vs1: Int, vs2: Int, oldType: BigInt): Unit = {
+        var limit = 0
+        while (!dut.io.ready.peek().litToBoolean && limit < 10) { dut.clock.step(); limit += 1 }
+        dut.io.ready.expect(true.B)
+        dut.io.inst.poke(word.U)
+        dut.io.valid.poke(true.B)
+        dut.clock.step()
+        dut.io.valid.poke(false.B)
+        limit = 0
+        while (!dut.io.outValid.peek().litToBoolean && limit < 10) { dut.clock.step(); limit += 1 }
+        dut.io.outValid.expect(true.B)
+        dut.io.srcType(0).expect(SrcType.vp)
+        dut.io.srcType(1).expect(SrcType.vp)
+        dut.io.srcType(2).expect(oldType.U)
+        dut.io.lsrc(0).expect(vs1.U)
+        dut.io.lsrc(1).expect(vs2.U)
+        dut.io.ldest.expect(vd.U)
+        dut.clock.step(2)
+      }
+      for (vd <- Seq(0, 8, 9, 31); vs1 <- Seq(0, 8, 31); vs2 <- Seq(0, 9, 31)) {
+        val word = BigInt(0x0200200b) | (BigInt(vs2) << 20) | (BigInt(vs1) << 15) | (BigInt(vd) << 7)
+        check(word,vd,vs1,vs2,SrcType.no.litValue)
+      }
+      // vmacc.vv v10,v9,v8：确实需要旧目的值参与运算的对照指令。
+      check(BigInt(0xb6942557L),10,8,9,SrcType.vp.litValue)
+    }
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/test/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8Test.scala b/src/test/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8Test.scala

+++ b/src/test/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8Test.scala
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector
+
+import chisel3._
+import chiseltest._
+import org.scalatest.flatspec.AnyFlatSpec
+import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers
+import scala.util.Random
+
+class VDot8Test extends AnyFlatSpec with ChiselScalatestTester with Matchers {
+  private def pack(bytes: Seq[Int], high: BigInt): BigInt =
+    (high << 64) | bytes.zipWithIndex.map { case (b, i) => BigInt(b & 255) << (8 * i) }.reduce(_ | _)
+
+  behavior of "VDot8"
+  it should "produce exact signed sums with enabled stages, bubbles and poisoned upper bytes" in {
+    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
+      val random = new Random(0x56444f54L)
+      val directed = Seq(
+        (1 to 8, Seq.fill(8)(1)),
+        (1 to 8, (1 to 8).reverse),
+        ((1 to 8).map(-_), Seq.fill(8)(1)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(-128)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(127), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(0), Seq.fill(8)(-128))
+      )
+      val vectors = directed ++ Seq.fill(1000)(
+        (Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128), Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128)))
+      var stage1: Option[BigInt] = None
+      var stage2: Option[BigInt] = None
+      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
+      dut.io.vs1.poke(0.U)
+      dut.io.vs2.poke(0.U)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      for ((a, b) <- vectors) {
+        // 分别建模每个带使能的寄存器，覆盖同时推进、
+        // 禁用保持，以及没有新输入时的后级传递。
+        for (_ <- 0 until (if (random.nextBoolean()) 1 else 2)) {
+          val en1 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          val en2 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          val sum = BigInt(a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => x * y }.sum) & 0xffffffffL
+          dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(a, BigInt(64, random)).U)
+          dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(b, BigInt(64, random)).U)
+          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
+          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
+          val next2 = if (en2) stage1 else stage2
+          if (en1) stage1 = Some(sum)
+          dut.clock.step()
+          stage2 = next2
+          stage2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
+        }
+      }
+      // 显式检查上界：18 位有符号数无法容纳该结果。
+      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
+      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.result.expect(BigInt(131072).U)
+    }
+  }
+
+  it should "hold a negative full-register result while disabled inputs keep changing" in {
+    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
+      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(127), 0).U)
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      val expected = BigInt(-130048) & BigInt("ffffffff", 16)
+      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
+      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
+      val random = new Random(0x484f4c44L)
+      for (_ <- 0 until 96) {
+        dut.io.vs1.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
+        dut.io.vs2.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
+        dut.clock.step()
+        dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
+      }
+      // 第一级禁用保持时，乘积还必须能供后续第二级正确使用。
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
+    }
+  }
+
+  it should "switch e8 and e16 with independent stage enables and exact wide endpoints across seeds" in {
+    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      var s1: Option[BigInt] = None
+      var s2: Option[BigInt] = None
+      for (seed <- Seq(1L, 0x56444f54L, 0x9e3779b9L, 0xdeadbeefL)) {
+        val random = new Random(seed)
+        for (n <- 0 until 520) {
+          val bits = if (n % 2 == 0) 16 else 8
+          val mask = (BigInt(1) << bits) - 1
+          val min = -(1 << (bits - 1))
+          val a = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 4) min else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
+          val b = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 2) min else if (n < 4) -min - 1 else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
+          def packed(xs: Seq[Int]): BigInt = xs.zipWithIndex.map {
+            case (v, i) => (BigInt(v) & mask) << (bits * i)
+          }.foldLeft(if (bits == 8) BigInt(64, random) << 64 else BigInt(0))(_ | _)
+          val expected = a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => BigInt(x) * BigInt(y) }.sum &
+            ((BigInt(1) << (if (bits == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
+          val en1 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          val en2 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          dut.io.sew16.poke((bits == 16).B)
+          dut.io.vs1.poke(packed(a).U)
+          dut.io.vs2.poke(packed(b).U)
+          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
+          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
+          val next = if (en2) s1 else s2
+          if (en1) s1 = Some(expected)
+          dut.clock.step()
+          s2 = next
+          s2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
+        }
+      }
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      s1.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
+    }
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/test/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDotIntegrationTest.scala b/src/test/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDotIntegrationTest.scala
